title: Production Planner
description:
At Harvey Performance Company, we're more than a team; we're a community. Our thriving, dynamic, and rapidly expanding organization values community, celebrates success, and fosters personal and professional growth opportunities.

Taken

The opportunity 
Harvey Performance Company manufactures consumable precision cutting tools for industrial customers. We are seeking an experienced Production Planner to own production scheduling and material planning across our manufacturing operations.

This role is responsible for translating demand forecasts and customer orders into achievable production schedules, ensuring material and capacity availability through disciplined use of SAP/Epicor ERP and Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and driving on-time delivery in a fast-paced, high-volume parts production environment

In this role, you will be responsible for 

- Develop, publish, and maintain detailed production schedules across manufacturing cells/lines to meet customer demand, on-time delivery targets, and inventory objectives.

- Own and execute Material Requirements Planning (MRP) within SAP/Epicor ERP, reviewing planned orders, exception messages, and net requirements to ensure timely material availability.

- Maintain accuracy of SAP planning master data, including planning parameters, lead times, lot sizes, safety stock levels, BOMs, routings, etc.

- Balance production capacity against demand forecasts and customer orders, adjusting schedules for a high-volume, high-mix precision manufacturing environment.

- Partner with Purchasing/Supply Chain to resolve material shortages, expedite critical components, and manage supplier lead times.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and Customer Service/Sales to resolve scheduling conflicts and support new product introductions.

- Monitor work-in-process (WIP), backlog, and finished goods inventory; identify and drive inventory optimization opportunities.

- Participate in and support the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, providing planning input and capacity analysis.

- Track and report key planning KPIs (on-time delivery, schedule adherence, machine/labor utilization, inventory turns) to operations leadership.

- Identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to planning processes, systems, and data integrity (Lean/Six Sigma principles).

- Support daily production meetings and escalating schedule risks proactively.

Vereisten

You’ll bring: 

- Minimum 5 years of production planning/scheduling experience in a high-volume parts manufacturing environment (required).

- Demonstrated hands-on experience with SAP ERP (PP and MM modules) and Epicor for production planning and material management (required).

- Highly competent in Material Requirements Planning (MRP) concepts, execution, and troubleshooting (required).

- Experience in precision manufacturing, cutting tools, metalworking, or a related consumable parts industry is strongly preferred.

- Strong analytical and Excel/data analysis skills; comfortable working with large datasets and planning reports.

- Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Proven ability to manage competing priorities and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

- Qualification in supply chain management, Business, Industrial Engineering and advantage or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Advanced knowledge of MRP logic, demand planning, and capacity planning principles.

- Strong problem-solving skills with a data-driven, root-cause approach.

- Ability to read and interpret BOMs, routings, and production schedules.

- Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.

- High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Benefits

What Harvey provides: 
Do you want to get the very best out of yourself? So do we! That’s why, in addition to great colleagues and a cutting-edge high-tech environment, we offer

- a competitive, market-based salary of €55.000,- to €65.000,-

- a high degree of independence, responsibility, and opportunities to learn

- an in-house fitness center

- 26 vacation days

- several fun company outings and parties each year

- Occasional travel to other group/ divisional manufacturing sites

Tasks

- Flexibel en comfortabel in een veranderende omgeving, met oog voor procesverbeteringen.

- Goede beheersing van Microsoft Office-applicaties, met name Outlook, Excel en PowerPoint.

Talen

- Vloeiend Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Benefits

Unsere Kunden sind Unternehmen der Energiewirtschaft, die sich auf funktionierende Prozesse verlassen müssen. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unserer Software. Du kennst unsere Produkte so gut wie ein Anwender und prüfst neue Funktionen, bevor sie zum Kunden gehen. Genau dieses Produktwissen macht dich im Gespräch mit Bestands- und Neukunden glaubwürdig.

Produkt & Test 

- Du testest neue Funktionen und Releases fachlich aus Sicht unserer Kunden und nimmst sie ab.

- Du erstellst strukturierte Testszenarien und Testfälle und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse.

- Du beschreibst Fehler und Verbesserungsvorschläge so, dass unsere Entwicklung damit arbeiten kann.

- Du bringst Anforderungen und Feedback unserer Kunden in die Weiterentwicklung der Produkte ein.

Kunden & Vertrieb

- Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden als feste Ansprechperson: von Fragen zur Anwendung bis zur Weiterentwicklung der Zusammenarbeit.

- Du gewinnst neue Kunden. Dazu gehören Produktpräsentationen, Angebote und Verhandlungen.

- Du stellst envago auf Fachmessen und bei Kundenterminen vor (bis zu ca. 12 Reisetage im Jahr).

- Du hast mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung, im Vertrieb oder im Produktumfeld, idealerweise mit B2B-Software.

- Du musst nicht programmieren können, hast aber ein gutes technisches Verständnis. Du willst verstehen, wie Software funktioniert und wie Kunden sie nutzen.

- Du arbeitest sorgfältig und strukturiert. Fehler, die anderen entgehen, fallen dir auf.

- Du trittst sicher und verbindlich gegenüber Kunden auf und verhandelst gern.

- Kenntnisse der Energiewirtschaft (Netzbetrieb, Messstellenbetrieb, Zählerwesen) sind von Vorteil.

- Deutsch sprichst du verhandlungssicher.

- Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B.

- Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design

-

Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

title: Strategische:r Einkäufer:in – Halbleitermaterialien (w/m/d)
description:
Über uns 

Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum der Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Wir sehen die tiefgreifenden Auswirkungen, die unsere Graphen-Lösungen auf die Umgestaltung der Branche habenwerden. Wir laden dich ein, mit uns gemeinsam den Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Die Vision lautet: Beweise allen, dass du etwas grundlegend verändern kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, wie Dinge anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam können wir das Paradigma, wie die Welt zusammenhängt, verändern.

Unsere Technologie 

Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. Wir verbinden Chips mit Computernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung.

Kurz gesagt , wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden so die Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie mittels Graphen.

Deine Rolle 

In dieser Position verantwortest du die strategische Beschaffung und das Lieferantenmanagement für Materialien, die für die Fertigung von Halbleitern unverzichtbar sind. Du stellst die Versorgungssicherheit sicher, optimierst die Gesamtkosten über den gesamten Beschaffungslebenszyklus hinweg und gewährleistest die Einhaltung der Qualitätsanforderungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl die sich stets weiterentwickelnden technologischen Anforderungen als auch die Veränderungen der Marktbedingungen.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Deine Hauptaufgabe ist es, globale Beschaffungsstrategien für Halbleitermaterialien wie Wafer, Fotolacke, CMP-Suspensionen, Spezialgase oder Chemikalien zu entwickeln und zu implementieren.

- Du identifizierst, qualifizierst und steuerst strategisch wichtige Lieferanten und stellst dabei sicher, dass sie optimal auf unsere Technologie-Roadmaps, Qualitätsstandards und Produktionsanforderungen abgestimmt sind.

- Beim Verhandeln von Verträgen, Preisen und sonstigen Konditionen hast du unsere Kostenziele immer im Blick und sicherst gleichzeitig eine verlässliche Belieferung.

- Darüber hinaus beobachtest du kontinuierlich die Märkte für Halbleitermaterialien, die Leistung der Lieferanten, Preistrends sowie Risiken in der Lieferkette, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielte Maßnahmen zur Risikominderung zu entwickeln.

- In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus R&D, Process Engineering, Qualitätssicherung und Fertigung stimmst du die Materialbeschaffung bestmöglich auf die technologischen Vorgaben und Produktionsanforderungen ab.

- Bei der Einführung neuer Produkte unterstützt du tatkräftig, indem du Materialien beschaffst, die den neuen Prozessanforderungen und Skalierungszielen gerecht werden.

- Du steuerst die Performance, pflegst die Lieferantenbeziehungen und kümmerst dich um das Reporting in Bezug auf unsere Unternehmensziele.

Das bringst du mit 

- Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Supply Chain Management, Ingenieur- oder Materialwissenschaften, Physik, BWL (oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang)

- Mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Einkauf, Strategic Sourcing oder Supply Chain Management, vorzugsweise in der Halbleiterindustrie, Elektronikbranche oder Hightech-Fertigung

- Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfolge in Bezug auf Vertragsverhandlungen, Lieferantenmanagement und Kostenoptimierung

- Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Halbleitermaterialien und -prozesse, z. B. Wafer, Spezialgase, Chemikalien, Fotolacke, Lithografie, Ätzen und Metallisierungsmaterialien

- Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Umgang mit ERP- oder Einkaufssystemen und Datenanalysetools

- Analytisches Denken, Kommunikationsstärke und ein gutes Gespür im Umgang mit verschiedenen Stakeholder:innen

- Verhandlungssicheres Englisch (Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus)

- Die Bereitschaft, mind. 1x pro Woche in unserem Aachener Büro zu arbeiten

Unsere Kultur 

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel — wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit du dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Deine Gesundheit und deine Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Dein Wohlbefinden steht an erster Stelle. Wir bieten dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit hervorragenden Versicherungs-, Renten- und virtuellen Aktienoptionen für deine geistige, körperliche und finanzielle Gesundheit. Dein Wohlbefinden ist unsere Priorität — heute und in der Zukunft.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt.

Wir verbinden Chips — und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließe dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will.

Kannst du dich in dieser Rolle und in unserem Unternehmen wiederfinden? Let's connect.

title: Defect Inspection Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Your Role 

As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection.

You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

What You’ll Do 

- Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

- Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

- Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

- Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

- Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

- Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

- Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

- Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification

- Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams

What You Bring 

- A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field

- 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection

- Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly

- Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning

- Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC)

- Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta

- Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability

- Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities

- Proficiency in JMP for statistical analysis, data visualization and DOE

- Familiarity with MATLAB or Python is an advantage

- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions

What We Offer 

- The opportunity to work on defect inspection for an integrated graphene photonics process flow

- A cleanroom-based role with close collaboration across process, equipment and integration teams

Our work culture 

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key-we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: Customer Care Specialist (m/w/d) – Finanz- und Buchhaltungsplattformen
description:
About Us 

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Über die Rolle 

Du wirst Teil unseres Customer Care Teams für Perk Spend, unsere Plattform für Ausgabenmanagement. Dort laufen Mitarbeiterausgaben, Lieferantenrechnungen und Firmenkartenzahlungen an einem Ort zusammen, damit Finanzteams die Ausgaben ihres Unternehmens zusammen mit unserem Travel Produkt steuern können.

Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen schnell und richtig gute Unterstützung bekommen. Du beantwortest ihre Fragen, löst Probleme und hinterlässt bei jedem Kontakt einen guten Eindruck. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit anderen Teams zusammen und lernst unser Produkt, das sich ständig weiterentwickelt, von Grund auf kennen. So hilfst du Kund:innen, die passende Lösung für ihre Anforderungen zu finden. Was uns dabei wichtig ist: Transparenz, Empathie und Effizienz.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer deutschsprachigen Kund:innen per E-Mail und Telefon, schnell und kompetent

- Du analysierst Probleme, findest Lösungen, gibst korrekte Informationen weiter und fasst nach, wo nötig

- Du erstellst Tickets, dokumentierst jeden Kontakt und eskalierst komplexe Fälle an die zuständigen Teams

- Du verfolgst gemeldete Vorfälle und Bugs eigenverantwortlich, bis sie gelöst sind

- Intern bist du die erste Anlaufstelle, wenn es um die operative Nutzung unserer Software geht

Das bringst du mit 

- Erfahrung im technischen Support bei einem Unternehmen aus FinTech, SaaS oder Buchhaltungssoftware

- Du behältst auch bei vielen Aufgaben und hohem Tempo den Überblick

- Du arbeitest strukturiert und genau

- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch, weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus

- Ein Hintergrund in Finanzen oder Buchhaltung ist ein großer Pluspunkt

- Erfahrung mit vielen externen Kundenanfragen und internen Abstimmungen im Team ist ein Plus

Das bieten wir 

- 30 Tage Urlaub plus alle gesetzlichen Feiertage

- Dein Perk nach Wahl: Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft oder BVG Ticket

- Attraktives Gehalt und Mitarbeiterbeteiligung an Perk

- Teamevents, darunter unser jährliches Sommerfest

- Unterstützung für dein Wohlbefinden über Spring Health: je 12 Sitzungen Therapie und Coaching für dich und deine Liebsten, ohne lange Wartezeit

- Flexible Vergütungsoptionen, damit dein Geld weiter reicht

- 17 Wochen bezahlte Elternzeit im ersten Lebensjahr deines Kindes

- 16 bezahlte Stunden pro Jahr für ehrenamtliches Engagement

- Bis zu 20 Tage pro Jahr Work from Anywhere

- Vier Wochen bezahltes Sabbatical nach fünf Jahren bei Perk

- Unterstützung beim Umzug an einen unserer Standorte

Bewerbungsprozess 

- Kennenlernen mit Talent Acquisition (30 Minuten, virtuell)

- Assessment und Gespräch mit der Teamleitung (virtuell)

- Abschlussgespräch (30 Minuten, vor Ort)

AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work 

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Founding Lead Engineer — AI & Workflow Automation
description:
Founding Lead Engineer — AI & Workflow Automation 

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and leading companies. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs, we combine early-stage capital with a hands-on Venture Studio team across product, engineering, growth, talent and fundraising.

We’re now building a new venture tackling one of Germany’s biggest labour-market challenges: how to find, engage and hire skilled workers at scale. 

We’re looking for a hands-on Lead Engineer with founder ambitions to build the first product from scratch, with the opportunity to become the venture’s Technical Co-Founder.

The opportunity 

Recruiting skilled workers is still remarkably manual. Candidates are found across fragmented channels, contacted via WhatsApp or phone, qualified one by one, matched against roles and repeatedly chased for missing information.

We believe a large part of this workflow can be fundamentally redesigned using AI, conversational interfaces and automation .

You would build the first version: from candidate acquisition and qualification to matching, follow-up and integrations into existing recruiting workflows.

What we’re looking for 

- Strong full-stack engineer able to build independently from zero to working product

- Experience automating messy, real-world workflows

- Hands-on experience shipping LLM / AI-agent functionality to users

- Comfortable connecting APIs, databases, messaging tools and third-party systems

- Product-minded: you care about whether technology actually removes work and improves conversion

- High ownership and entrepreneurial ambition — whether as a founder, early engineer, freelancer or technical operator

- Familiarity with the DACH market; German strongly preferred

Particularly relevant 

Experience with recruitment or HR tech, ATS/CRM integrations, WhatsApp, voice AI, n8n/Make, matching systems, marketplaces or workflow-heavy SaaS would be highly relevant.

What we offer 

You’ll build the company from day one with capital and hands-on support from Founders Factory , working alongside an experienced venture team and with access to our network of founders, operators, corporate partners and investors.

This is an opportunity to build first, validate quickly and potentially step in as Technical Co-Founder of an independent venture-backed company.

title: Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
description:
About the Role 

Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.

The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.

You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move. 

What You'll Own 

Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture 

- Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.

- Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.

- Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.

- Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.

Experimentation & Behavioral Economics 

- Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.

- Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.

- Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.

- Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.

Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance 

- Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.

- Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.

- Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.

- Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.

Fraud Policy & Global Governance 

- Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.

- Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.

- Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.

- Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Accountability 

- Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.

- Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.

- Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.

- Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.

What You'll Bring 

Education 

- MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.

- Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.

Experience 

- 8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.

- Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.

- Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.

- Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct advantage.

Technical & Analytical 

- Advanced proficiency in SQL and data analysis; able to build and pressure-test the analytical models that underpin policy decisions without delegating the logic to others.

- Fluency with experimentation methodology: test design, statistical significance, holdout analysis, and the translation of results into policy not just reporting.

- Experience working with or alongside engineering teams to define product and system requirements for rules-based or AI-assisted decisioning tools.

- Comfort with financial modeling: building the business case for compensation investment, forecasting spend impact, and tracking actuals against plan.

Leadership & Influence 

- Senior executive presence: able to walk into a GM, COO, or CFO conversation with a clear point of view, defend it under pressure, and leave with alignment.

- A credible voice with peers and upward stakeholders not because of title, but because of the quality of analysis and clarity of communication.

- Genuinely collaborative across markets and functions able to hold people to standards without damaging the relationships needed to sustain them.

title: Tactical Data Link Expert (All Genders)
description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments. 

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions. 

WHY JOIN US 

- The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty. 

- You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms. 

- We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing. 

About the Team 

Minerva is STARK's command and control software — the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Minerva team is a small, senior software group based in Berlin and Munich, working directly with our systems and hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities deployed in active operational environments. 
We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter — low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field. 

Your Mission 

Support the development, integration, testing, and operational use of tactical data link capabilities for STARK’s unmanned systems, Ground Control Stations, and wider command-and-control environments. You will help ensure that our systems can communicate reliably and securely with military networks, command posts, allied platforms, and mission systems. A key part of the role is to evaluate, understand, and integrate tactical communication standards and technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military data link solutions. You will translate operational communication requirements into practical integration concepts, test setups, and deployable system configurations. 

Responsibilities 

- Tactical Data Link Integration: Support the integration of tactical data link capabilities such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military communication systems into STARK platforms and Ground Control Station environments. 

- Interoperability Concepts: Define and support communication concepts that enable reliable data exchange between unmanned systems, GCS setups, command centers, allied platforms, and external mission systems. 

- Requirements Translation: Translate operational and military communication requirements into technical integration requirements, interface definitions, test needs, and subsystem-level implementation concepts.

title: Director Media (Mensch)
description:
About WPP Media 

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Das bieten wir dir: 

- Work-Life-Balance : Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.

- Vacation mode on : Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.

- Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.

- Practice makes perfect : Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.

- More than just a job : Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.

- Be yourself : Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das bewegst du: 

Als Director Media (Mensch) übernimmst du die strategische und operative Verantwortung für einen unserer namhaften Kunden. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team betreust du das Budgetvolumen für zukunftweisende Mediakampagnen. 

- Teamführung & Enablement: Du führst ein Team ca. 8 Mitarbeitenden, förderst deren individuelle Entwicklung und berichtest direkt an den Agency Lead.

- Strategische Kundenberatung: Du agierst als zentraler Sparringspartner und baust die langjährige, sehr vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehung weiter aus.

- Zukunftsthemen & Innovation: Du treibst übergeordnete Media-Innovationen voran – von AI, Data und Consumer Experience bis hin zu Award-Projekten.

- Stakeholder Management & Internationalität: Du steuerst verlässlich die Zusammenarbeit mit Ansprechpartnern in Deutschland sowie zentralen europäischen Teams und führst strategische Termine und Workshops (auf Deutsch und Englisch).

- Agenturentwicklung: Über die Kundenthemen hinaus gestaltest du übergeordnete Agenturprozesse, Kultur und Zukunftsinitiativen aktiv mit.

Das zeichnet dich aus: 

- Expertise in Mediaberatung: Du bringst mehrjährige (ca. 6–8+ Jahre) relevante Erfahrung in der Mediastrategie und Kundenberatung aus dem Agenturumfeld mit.

- Leadership: Du verfügst über fundierte Führungserfahrung, verstehst es, Teams zu begeistern sowie zu befähigen, und führst mit Empathie und Klarheit.

- Komplexitäts- & Budgetstärke: Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung großer Etats und bewegst dich souverän in vielschichtigen Kunden- und Konzernstrukturen.

- Sprachkompetenz: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für den regelmäßigen Austausch auf europäischer Ebene sind für dich selbstverständlich.

- Leidenschaft & Innovation: Du brennst für moderne Media-Trends (AI, Data, Consumer Experience) und hast Lust, sowohl die Marken deines Kunden als auch unsere Agentur kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #kommunikativ #führungsstark #strategisch #beziehungsstark #innovativ 

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media: 

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.

WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Tools & Systems
description:
Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role: 
We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering. 

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems. 

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering. 

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership. 

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role. 

What you'll do: 

- Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering. 

- Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools. 

- Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency. 

- Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries. 

- Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions. 

- Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams. 

What you'll bring: 
Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below. 

- Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful. 

- Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform. 

- Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling. 

- Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions. 

- Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use. 

How you work: 

- You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state. 

- You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve. 

- You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns. 

- You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment. 

- You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas. 

What you’ll get: 

- Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team 

- Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage 

- Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) 

- Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together 

- Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday 

- One-time home office stipend 

- Annual professional development budget 

- Quarterly well-being stipend 

- Considerable paid parental leave 

- Employee referral bonus program 

- Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) 

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging 

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientation s, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Senior Consulting Systems Engineer Germany, Strategic Accounts (Automotive and Manufacturing)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Senior Consulting Systems Engineer Germany, Strategic Accounts 

(Automotive) 

Do you keep up with the latest trends, are you a disruptive thinker and do you have experience of driving cultural change in organisations? If Yes - then this is the right role for you.

The Strategic Accounts business is the growth area for Everpure and the Client Technical Director (CTD), known internally as a - Consulting System Engineer (CSE) - is a key role in engaging new and existing Automotive clients in conversations to help them transition from traditional storage-centric models to a modern data platform - unlocking the power of their data.

As Client Technical Director you are a senior level technical Solutions Architect who will work with and focus on Everpure’s Strategic clients - for this role it will be German Automotive clients with a focus on southern Germany, plus other selected accounts. In turn, you will also work in collaboration with Everpure’s Enterprise and Field pre-sales and account teams 

You are expected also to have a detailed grasp of IT industry trends, broad and deep IT industry experience (especially Automotive, their Tier 1 suppliers and ecosystems, plus the wider Manufacturing supply chain and build demands) and a high degree of business acumen and will be working in the forefront of Everpure's global sales capability.

You will be required to work closely with your customer base (so frequent travel within Germany is a strong requirement), building a trusted relationship, identifying and quantifying outcome based opportunities that can be delivered from our portfolio.

You must be knowledgeable across industry, business, IT strategy, use cases and technology domains and be comfortable presenting to C-Suite clients, discussing process with business managers or working with developers on solution strategy, architecture and code, and with storage admins designing operating models – from boardroom to hackathon to storage ops. Critically you will be accustomed to creating a value proposition that is directly linked to a client’s business model, challenges and issues plus their future vision.

You will be an expert in quickly learning new business models and drivers and will be able to articulate, to multiple customer stakeholder personas across different regions and countries. This will include presenting and explaining the benefits and differentiators of our chosen technology, how our solution has been mapped to meet their industry, business and operational requirements, our implementation methods, and the proposed commercial and financial models.

Building and articulating financial and commercial models with their benefits to our customers, and internal stakeholders is a key aspect of the ever evolving role.

It is expected that you will be able to translate our core values, differentiators and capabilities across our portfolio, plus articulate previous customer success stories, benefits seen and acknowledged by customers with known outcomes to multiple levels of stakeholders within the strategic accounts.

You have gravitas and authenticity. You will be expected to have first class interpersonal skills combined with a comfortable, open and compelling communication and presentation style. You also bring a high degree of diplomacy and a strong EQ. It is imperative that we can look at our value propositions from the viewpoint of our customers, therefore empathy is critical.

SHOULD YOU ACCEPT THIS CHALLENGE, AS A CTD AT EVERPURE YOU WILL WORK ON... 

- Use Case Development and Solution Definition: 

Define end‑to‑end solutions and use cases that address the specific realities of German and global Automotives – from production and supply chain to digital services and connected vehicles.

Shape our global automotive strategy and footprint across the largest German OEMs and suppliers by mapping industry trends, business drivers, and technical requirements to Everpure’s portfolio and ecosystem.

Influence implementation methods, technology choices and commercial / financial models so that our solutions deliver clear, measurable outcomes for customers.

- Stakeholder Management: 

Understand stakeholders, their drivers, challenges, their goals and expectations, and effectively communicate the right messages to them. You will spend a large portion of your time with your customers face to face, (in and around Germany primarily, but also globally covering the leading German Automotive accounts), your partners, Alliances, Global Integrators and key stakeholders.

- Financial Acumen: 

Calculate Total Cost of Ownership scenarios for customers, explaining how they align with their challenges and Everpure’s benefits.

- Leadership and Collaboration: 

Lead large IT projects, establish yourself as a thought leader and trusted advisor, collaborate with sales, engineering, and product management teams. Have experience of working across multiple global and local partners.

- Collateral Production :

Create client collateral, including presentations, papers, demonstrations, proofs of concepts, and contribute to joint offerings with other Everpure teams.

- Sales Guidance: 

Guide the Sales team in positioning, shaping and closing the right solutions in a competitive environment.

- Technical Leadership: 

Provide technical leadership and mentoring for the local and regional Systems Engineering organisation.

Represent Pure at industry events, field marketing activities and communities (including those focused on women in tech and diverse talent).

- Market Insight: 

Track key trends in Automotive and Manufacturing (e.g. software‑defined vehicles ADAS & AD, Industry 4.0, sustainability, data sovereignty and primacy & AI) and connect them to Everpure’s technology strategy.

Understand the competitive landscape and be able to articulate where Pure differentiates and how our solutions support the German market’s specific requirements.

Bring back customer and market insights to influence our roadmap and go‑to‑market.

- Culture & Inclusion: 

Help maintain and evolve Everpure’s technical and customer‑first culture .

Act as a role model who creates inclusive environments , supports diverse talent, and helps us attract and retain top technical people

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE... 

1.Technical Expertise: 

Strong technical background across infrastructure and data : storage, compute, databases, networking, virtualisation and/or cloud‑native architectures.

Solid experience with data management and storage technologies , and how they support mission‑critical workloads in Automotive and Manufacturing.

Understanding of key manufacturing processes and outcomes , and a deep appreciation of the Automotive value chain – OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, production plants, logistics and digital services.

- Versatility: 

Familiarity with areas such as data & analytics / data science, modern IT architecture modelling, Agile and DevOps, automation and infrastructure as code, IT operations and IT security .

Ability to quickly learn new platforms, tools and architectures and translate them into simple, business‑relevant language .

- Strategic Thinking: 

Experience working with large, global or strategic accounts – ideally in or with German enterprise customers (automotive experience is beneficial)

Ability to move comfortably between big‑picture strategy and hands‑on detail , and to structure complex problems into clear options and recommendations.

- Communication Skills: 

Outstanding communication skills in German and English (Native/Bilingual German and business‑fluent English required).

Confidence in presenting to C‑Level, senior business leaders and technical teams – and in facilitating workshops where different perspectives need to be heard.

High emotional intelligence, empathy and diplomacy ; you naturally build trust and foster collaborative discussions.

- Industry Knowledge :

Strong understanding of commercial and disruptive technology trends in the Automotive and Manufacturing markets in Germany, with existing relationships within southern Germany automotives strongly preferred.

Knowledge of major competitors and partner ecosystems , and the ability to position Pure’s differentiators for the right use cases.

- Learning Orientation: 

A growth and learning orientation – you actively invest in your own development and stay curious about new technologies, methods and industry trends.

Willingness to dedicate a minimum of 10% of your time to training, certifications and participation in industry and community events.

#LI-HYBRID

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US: 

- Innovation : We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

- Growth : We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

- Team : We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY: 

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM: 

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

title: DACH Enterprise Account Executive – SAP Ecosystem & Digital Transformation (m/f/d)
description:
DACH Enterprise Account Executive – SAP Ecosystem & Digital Transformation (m/f/d) 

Position Summary: 

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, reporting to the VP of Global GTM. We are seeking an elite, high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition across top-tier accounts. Combining large-enterprise sophistication with an aggressive, entrepreneurial hunting mindset, you will architect transformational security deals, engage C-level stakeholders, and position business resilience for the world’s most mission-critical ERP environments.

Key Responsibilities 

Drive Strategic Revenue: Own the full sales lifecycle for Global 2000 accounts, positioning the Onapsis Platform as the essential security layer for SAP and Business Critical Applications. 

The SAP "Triple Threat": 

- Direct Sales: Manage complex, high-value "land and expand" cycles.

- SAP Co-Sell: Partner with SAP Account Executives (AEs) and Enterprise Architects to attach Onapsis to S/4HANA and RISE migrations.

- GSI Alignment: Orchestrate go-to-market strategies with Global Systems Integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, PwC) who are leading the world's largest SAP transformations.

C-Suite Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs and CIOs, translating technical vulnerabilities into business risks (e.g., SOX compliance, financial downtime, and data integrity).

Territory Orchestration: Develop and execute an annual territory plan focused on "White Space" analysis within the SAP installed base.

Forecast Accuracy: Maintain a high level of "Sales Hygiene" within CRM, delivering predictable weekly and monthly forecasts aligned with SAP’s rigorous reporting standards.

Required Skills/Experience: 

- Proven Enterprise Track Record: 7–10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a proven history of selling complex software solutions within the SAP ecosystem (either at SAP or a top-tier partner).

- Cloud Transformation Expert: Deep understanding of the RISE with SAP framework, Clean Core strategy, and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) .

- Consistent High Achiever: Consistent record of quota over-achievement, regularly closing seven-figure ARR deals across Global 2000 accounts with complex buying committees.

- Alliance Savvy: Demonstrated success in "partner-first" selling, particularly with GSIs and SAP’s regional field teams.

- Communication: Exceptional executive presence; ability to move seamlessly from a technical discussion with a Basis Lead to a strategic ROI pitch with a CFO.

- Ability to travel: We believe that our business is a people business and that trust is built in person. Between 25-50% travel required. 

Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proactive self-starter with the drive to build a territory from scratch and take full ownership of business growth.Languages: Professional fluency in both German and English (written and spoken). 

What You will get: 

- You can expect a job with responsible tasks and creative opportunities, an attractive salary and extensive benefits (including JobRad, Focus Friday and much more).

- You have flexible working hours with us. In addition, you can work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement.

- We support our employees with 5 fully paid sick days per child and subsidize childcare up to primary school age.

- In addition to an individual onboarding and buddy program, we offer comprehensive training opportunities and english language classes.

- We offer 30 days of paid vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek) for optimal work-life balance.

- Furthermore, you can expect an innovative and attractive workplace with flat hierarchies and respectful and solution-oriented communication.

- Equity in a late-stage, high-growth leader backed by top-tier VC/PE firms.

- The chance to represent the only cybersecurity solution endorsed by SAP.

About Onapsis: 

Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. The Onapsis Platform delivers vulnerability management, change assurance, and continuous compliance for business applications from leading vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and others. The Onapsis Platform is powered by the Onapsis Research Labs, the team responsible for the discovery and mitigation of more than 1,000 zero-day vulnerabilities in business applications.

Onapsis is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Dallas, TX, Heidelberg, Germany, Bucharest, Romania, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, and proudly serves hundreds of the world’s leading brands, including close to 30% of the Forbes Global 100, six of the top 10 automotive companies, five of the top 10 chemical companies, four of the top 10 technology companies, and three of the top 10 oil and gas companies.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager  | Germany | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity: 

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value.

Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execution (blogs, webinar outlines, video scripts, etc). Our team is full of people who crave impact and independence - if you are seeking a role with narrow scope where you run a defined playbook, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Be Doing: 

- Actively partner with and teach product managers to define product value, messaging, and go-to-market strategy, from competitive positioning to sales enablement collateral.

- Partner with product management, engineering and various go-to-market functions to create materials that help customers evaluate and adopt our products: reference architectures, implementation guides, detailed product information and more.

- Own customer lifecycle campaigns (competitive positioning, retention, upsell/cross-sell) to strategically shape marketing programs and drive growth across the entire customer journey.

- Conduct market and customer research to understand pain points, competition and opportunities.

- Teach go-to-market and sales teams our products’ capabilities and the value they provide, deliver training and enablement, ensure customer facing teams are able to effectively engage with customers, partners, and prospects.

What Makes You a Great Fit: 

- 4+ years of relevant experience (product marketing, solutions marketing, product management)

- Experience with marketing and selling to a technical audience

- A passion for open source, cloud native, and infrastructure technologies 

- Proven ability to take on complex projects and efficiently drive them from start to finish

- Ability to clearly articulate the value of technical products to customers and sellers alike

- Experience leading product or feature launches autonomously as well as part of a team

- Experience working with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate messaging and workflows

- Comfort working with a variety of internal and external stakeholders in complicated processes

- Strong product and technical curiosity that translate to clear packaging, positioning, and messaging

- Demonstrated quantitative analytical skills for analyzing campaign performance, evaluating lifecycle metrics, and making data-driven recommendations.

- Exceptional writing and communication skills

- A high “say-do” ratio in executing and delivering impact 

Compensation & Rewards: 

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 97,034 - EUR 116,441. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. 

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 

- 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

- Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

- Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

- Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

- Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

- Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

- Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

- Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

- Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

- In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 

- Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

title: Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Allow us to introduce ourselves 

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀 

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process , and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here 

Your mission as an Analytics Engineer 

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer (m/f/d) with strong data engineering skills to join our Data team and help build a scalable, reliable, and well-structured data foundation across Appinio.
In this role, you will design and maintain clean, scalable data models that make data easy to access, understand, and use across the organisation. You will use SQL, dbt, and Python to transform raw data into meaningful datasets, develop automated workflows, and ensure consistency and reliability across our data warehouse.
Beyond data modelling, you will contribute to building, maintaining, and optimising data pipelines and integrations. You will work with APIs, databases, and third-party data sources to ensure reliable data ingestion, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and improve the overall stability and performance of our data infrastructure.
Working closely with Analytics, Product, Engineering, and business teams, you will help define and standardise key business metrics such as revenue, bookings, and churn, ensuring a single source of truth across the company. You will also take ownership of data quality through automated testing, validation, and monitoring across the data lifecycle.
You will explore and leverage AI-powered tools to improve development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance data engineering and analytics processes. You will also help prepare our data foundation for AI-driven analytics by ensuring that data models, business definitions, and documentation are structured, consistent, and accessible.
You will contribute to documentation, performance optimisation, and the continuous improvement of our data stack, helping us build a robust and scalable data platform that enables teams across Appinio to make faster, more informed decisions.

What you’ll be doing 

- Data Modeling: Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable data models in the data warehouse using SQL and dbt, making data accessible and reliable for analysts and business users.

- Data Transformation: Develop and maintain data transformation workflows, turning raw data from multiple sources into structured, analytics-ready datasets.

- Data Pipelines & Integration: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations, ensuring reliable data ingestion from APIs, databases, and third-party systems into the data warehouse.

- Data Quality & Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability by implementing automated tests, validations, monitoring, and proactive issue resolution across data pipelines and models.

- Documentation: Document data models, pipelines, business definitions, and transformation logic to ensure transparency, maintainability, and knowledge sharing.

- Business Logic Ownership: Define, implement, and standardize key business metrics (e.g. revenue, bookings, churn) to ensure consistency across reporting and analytics.

- Collaboration: Work closely with analysts, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable, scalable data solutions.

- Performance & Infrastructure Optimization: Optimize SQL queries, dbt models, and data pipelines for performance, scalability, and efficient use of data warehouse resources.

You will thrive in this role if 

- Strong SQL & Data Modeling Skills: You have excellent SQL skills and hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data models in a modern data warehouse.

- Experience with dbt: You have practical experience using dbt to develop, test, document, and maintain reliable data transformation workflows.

- Data Engineering & Python: You are proficient in Python and have experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines, including integrations with APIs, databases, and third-party systems.

- Data Warehousing Knowledge: You understand modern data warehouse architectures and have experience working with cloud-based solutions such as Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery.

- Data Quality & Reliability: You have a strong understanding of data quality principles, automated testing, validation, and monitoring, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.

- Business Understanding: You can translate business requirements into reliable data models and clearly defined metrics, balancing technical quality with practical business needs.

- Problem-Solving & Ownership: You are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges, investigating root causes, and developing sustainable solutions.

- Collaboration & Communication: You communicate technical concepts clearly, work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and enjoy collaborating across teams.

- AI & Automation Mindset: You are curious about AI-powered development tools and actively explore opportunities to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity.

What’s in it for you? 

- Flexibility Policy - Average is 30 days taken, however, we do not have a hard cap of number of vacation days as we know life happens 

- Temporary work from abroad - If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year 

- All the hardware you need and your own MacBook 

- If you are located in Hamburg or Berlin, you'll get a Deutschland ticket or access to a mobility budget with the NAVIT app to get you to and from the office space 

- Subsidised Urban Sports Club or ClassPass membership based on location

- In case you’re located in one of the cities where most of our fellow Appinioneers are (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, London, Madrid, Barcelona, or New York), you can get access to our Co-working spaces 

Additional role details 

- This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in Germany, the UK, Portugal, the Netherlands, and Spain

- This role will report directly to our Team Lead, Business Intelligence

Our interview process 

- Screening Call with the Talent Acquisition team

- Hiring Manager interview

- Case Study 

- Executive Interview

- References

Kind reminder: Please ensure that your application is submitted in English.

This post not only outlines our ideal candidate but also serves as an inspiration for what this role can evolve into. Even if you consider yourself an 80% fit but have a genuine passion for this position, we encourage you to apply. We're eager to hear from individuals who share our enthusiasm. 

Appinio is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.
