SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote 

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role 

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation . This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO) .

Key Responsibilities 

SEO Strategy & Optimization 

- Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
- Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
- Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
- Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
- Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
- Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).
Paid Advertising & Lead Generation 

- Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads .
- Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
- Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
- Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
- Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.
Content Marketing & Website Management 

- Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
- Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
- Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms .
- Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.
Analytics, Reporting & Optimization 

- Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager .
- Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
- Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
- Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.
Marketing Automation & CRM 

- Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
- Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign .
- Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
- Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.
Required Qualifications 

- 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
- Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
- Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization .
- Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools .
- Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns .
- Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
- Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
- Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
- Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
- Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
- Availability during U.S. Business Hours .
Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) .
- Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
- Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
- Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
- Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
- Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.
What Makes You a Strong Fit 

- You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
- You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
- You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
- You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
- You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
- You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.
What a Typical Day Looks Like 

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

Success in this role will be measured through:

- Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
- Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
- Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
- Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
- Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
- Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
- Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
- Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.
Interview Process 

- Initial Application
- Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview 
- Recruiter Screening
- Client Interview
- Final Selection & Onboarding
Spark Hire Video Interview – Required 

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire .

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage . Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now 

If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results.

title: Senior Specialist, QA
description:
About Summit: 

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) 

- 
HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

- 
HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

- 
HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC) 

- 
HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland. 

Overview of Role: 

The Senior Specialist, QA will provide operational leadership and quality oversight for the review, approval and release-readiness of clinical and commercial product batches. 

The role is responsible for ensuring that batch documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, and compliant with applicable GMP requirements, approved procedures and regulatory commitments before submission to QA for final disposition or QP certification. The person will coordinate batch-release activities across Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and external manufacturing partners, ensuring that issues are identified, escalated and resolved in a timely manner. The position will also lead process improvements, support inspection readiness and promote high standards of data integrity and Good Documentation Practice across the batch-release process. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Batch Review and Release Readiness 

- Coordinate the end-to-end QA review of executed batch manufacturing, packaging, testing and release documentation for IMP and Commercial biological batch records. 

- Coordinate the preparation and collation of batch documentation required for final batch disposition or QP certification from internal and external sources. 

- Verify that batch records are complete, accurate, and compliant with approved procedures, specifications and applicable GMP requirements. 

- Confirm that relevant deviations, investigations, change controls, CAPAs, and laboratory results have been appropriately assessed and approved before release. 

- Identify documentation gaps, discrepancies and potential compliance risks, and coordinate their timely resolution. 

- Maintain oversight of batch-release priorities, review status, outstanding actions, and planned release dates. 

- Escalate critical issues or potential delays to Quality leadership and relevant stakeholders. 

- Ensure that batch-release documentation is appropriately archived and readily retrievable electronically. 

- Quality Systems and Compliance: 

- Ensure batch-release activities are performed in accordance with current GMP, Good Documentation Practice, data-integrity principles, and internal procedures. 

- Support the effective operation of quality systems associated with deviations, CAPAs, change controls, document control, and training. 

- Review and approve relevant quality documents, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, checklists, and batch-release procedures. 

- Maintain controlled documentation and ensure that current approved versions are available to relevant personnel. 

- Support periodic reviews of procedures and identify opportunities to strengthen compliance and operational effectiveness. 

- Promote the appropriate use of electronic quality and document management systems. 

- Act as a subject-matter expert for batch documentation, release-readiness and associated document-control processes for all batch release activities. 

- Internal Team Coordination (EU QA) 

- Provide day-to-day leadership and technical guidance to QA batch reviewers and supporting personnel. 

- Plan and allocate batch-review activities according to business priorities, product demand, and release timelines. 

- Monitor team workload, quality metrics, and completion of assigned activities. 

- Develop and deliver training in Good Documentation Practice, batch-record review and relevant quality-system processes. 

- Support onboarding and qualifications of new QA team members. 

- Foster a collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement culture within the QA function. 

- External Team Collaboration: 

- Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality Control / CMC, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Supply and other relevant functions to support timely batch release. 

- Coordinate with all Summit CMOs, testing laboratories and service providers to obtain missing documents and resolve release-related queries. 

- Communicate batch status, risks, priorities and outstanding actions clearly to internal and external stakeholders. 

- Support changes affecting batch documentation or release processes. 

- Participate in cross-functional meetings concerning batch disposition, documentation, readiness, and supply continuity internally. 

- Inspection Readiness and Continuous Improvement 

- Maintain batch-release processes and supporting records in a continuous state of inspection of readiness. 

- Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, internal audits, and supplier audits. 

- Retrieve and present batch documentation and quality-system records during audits and inspections. 

- Track batch-review metrics, recurring documentation issues, cycle times, and overdue actions. 

- Analyse trends and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, right-first-time performance and compliance. 

- Lead or contribute to Lean and process-optimization initiatives within the batch-release function. 

- Support the implementation and enhancement of electronic quality, document management and reporting systems. 

Qualifications and Experience 

- Essential 

- Recognized qualification in Quality, Pharmaceutical Science, Life Sciences, Engineering or related discipline. 

- Significant experience in Quality Assurance within a pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical or similarly regulated manufacturing environment – preferably in Biologic manufacturing, Packaging and Labelling environments. 

- Practical experience reviewing executed batch records and supporting batch disposition or QP certification activities. 

- Knowledge of GMP, Good Documentation Practice, and data-integrity requirements. 

- Experience working with deviations, investigations, CAPAs, and change controls. 

- Experience using electronic quality, document management and other enterprise-systems - systems such as MasterControl, NetSuite, Veeva Vault, TrackWise, SAP or equivalent platforms. 

- Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple priorities and deliver against critical release timelines. 

- Experience supporting the release of medicinal products or investigational medicinal products. 

- Experience working with contract manufacturing organizations and external testing laboratories 

- Key Competencies 

- Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy 

- Sound quality and compliance judgement 

- Leadership and team coordination 

- Effective prioritization and workload management 

- Problem-solving and risk-based decision-making 

- Clear communication and stakeholder management 

- Audit and inspection readiness 

- Data integrity and information governance 

- Process improvement and operational efficiency 

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment 

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. title: Systems Engineer
description:
80-100% | as soon as possible | Germany or Switzerland 

About Exeon 

Exeon is a Swiss cyber security company based in Zurich. Since 2016, we have been protecting critical infrastructures, financial institutions and enterprises whose operations fully rely on IT through AI-powered analysis of network communication. This makes the most sophisticated cyberattacks visible – attacks conventional tools fail to detect. We combine Swiss excellence with a flexible, remote-first, and collaborative culture, supporting passionate, ambitious professionals devoted to solving cybersecurity challenges and driving continuous innovation. 

What your impact will be like: 

As a Systems Engineer in our Solutions team, you will help design the components and data flow of our core products: how data gets in, how deployments are configured and operated, and how everything scales across very different customer environments, many of them on-prem and air-gapped. 

You’ll split your time between building (ingestion pipelines, automation, tooling) and deploying and operating (working with customers to get Exeon running reliably in their environments), so your work shapes both scalability and customer success.

In particular, you will:

- Build tooling and automation to simplify the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of Exeon.NDR, Exeon.UEBA, log collection and supporting components 

- Design, build, and maintain scalable log ingestion pipelines for a wide range of network and application log sources and formats, including parsing, normalization, and validation 

- Deploy and operate Exeon in customer environments (on-prem, private cloud, and hybrid), including sizing, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex issues 

- Work with customers to understand their data sources, infrastructure constraints, and security needs, and translate these into clear requirements for product and engineering teams 

- Contribute to customer support, documentation, and runbooks alongside your Solutions colleagues

What you can expect from us: 

Exeon offers an open company culture that values and encourages diversity, teamwork and a growth mindset. Our goal is to provide our employees with an exciting, supportive and motivating environment for personal growth and career development while ensuring that our team maintains a healthy work-life balance. We strive to achieve this by offering:

- An exciting and impactful job in a fast-growing Swiss cyber tech company expanding across Europe with manifold opportunities to shape your professional profile.

- Working in close collaboration with our interdisciplinary team and learning from our Security Experts, Data Scientists, and Business Professionals.

- Taking over responsibilities quickly and help shape and promote a cutting-edge security software.

- A high degree of trust, independence and flexibility, also in terms of working hours and place of work (remote or in the office).

- A competitive salary and appealing benefits package.

What you bring along: 

We are looking for a proactive, self-motivated and enthusiastic cyber security professional who is comfortable in a high-paced start-up environment and who shares our values. You should be confident with solving problems independently and communicating easily with both internal teams and directly with customers. You should also:

- 3-5 years of experience in systems engineering, data engineering, platform/infrastructure engineering, or a similar role 

- Working knowledge of network and application security and the telemetry relevant to detection 

- UNIX/Linux experience, including networking, troubleshooting, and performance tuning in containerized deployments (Docker and/or Kubernetes) 

- Strong programming skills in Python and Bash (or comparable languages), with a focus on automation and maintainable, production-quality code 

- Hands-on experience designing and operating data ingestion pipelines (e.g. syslog, Logstash/Fluentd/Vector, Elastic stack, or similar), including handling heterogeneous formats and high volumes 

- Comfortable with working in a largely remote team where clear communication is key to successful collaboration and impact. We are an English-speaking team but German fluency is appreciated when communicating to some customers 

- Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have:

- Solid understanding of network and application security fundamentals, common attack patterns, and the log and telemetry sources that matter for detection 

- Experience with SIEM, SOAR, or detection platforms (e.g. Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Security), or as a detection engineer or security analyst 

- Familiarity with network telemetry such as NetFlow/IPFIX, Zeek, or Suricata, and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK 

- Prior customer-facing or professional services experience.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Building the intelligence behind Solskin

Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive?

We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow.

In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist.

What you will do

This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day.

Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better.

Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. 

Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. 

Our stack: 

- Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch

- Frontend: React, TypeScript

- Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs

- Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB)

- DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana

What we are looking for

Required: 

- Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar.

- Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems.

- Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. 

- Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems.

- Cloud & data : You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS.

- Leadership attitude : You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader.

- Languages : English. German is a big plus.

- Hybrid setting : You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products.

- Availability : 100%, as soon as possible.

- Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position.

Preferred: 

- Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means.

- Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. 

- Frontend: React and TypeScript.

Mindset: 

- Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself.

- Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you.

- Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter.

Benefits

Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work.

Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company.

Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days.

Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out.

title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

- Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

- Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

- Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 

- 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

- 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

- 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities 

1. Storytelling That Converts 

- Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

- Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

- Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

- Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution 

- Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

- Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

- Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA 

- Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

- Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

- Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

- Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops 

- Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

- Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

- Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

- Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

What We Are Looking For 

Essential Experience & Qualifications 

- 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

- Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

- Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

- Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools.

- Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably.

- CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho.

Preferred Technical Skills 

- Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations

Mindset & Soft Skills 

- Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

- Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning.

- Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment.

Working Environment & Expectations 

- Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast.

- Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win.

- Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively.

Why join Papers? 

- Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means.

- High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes.

- Influence the Growth strategy from day one.

- Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth.

- 25 days paid vacation per year.

- Regular team events and retreats (at least quarterly).

- Support for your ongoing learning and development.r

title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Performance Engineer who is passionate about getting the most out of embedded systems — from low-level Linux tuning and hardware integration to high-performance video and data pipelines. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware, moving across the stack, and solving the kinds of problems where milliseconds, bandwidth, startup time, and system efficiency matter.

You will work across the AuterionOS ecosystem on topics such as:

- Embedded Linux performance and system tuning

- Low-latency video streaming and media pipelines

- C/C++, Python, and Bash-based platform development

- Hardware integration, system profiling, and end-to-end optimization

- Collaboration with experienced and driven engineers across Auterion

Responsibilities 

- Work within the Apps & Simulation team and collaborate with other development teams to build high-performance products for autonomous systems.

- Design, optimize, and maintain performance-critical components within AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.

- Improve end-to-end system behavior across compute, networking, video, and hardware interfaces, with a strong focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.

- Analyze and optimize demanding workloads such as real-time telemetry, video streaming, media processing, and communication between distributed system components.

- Investigate system bottlenecks across the full stack, from kernel and OS behavior to application-level code and tooling.

- Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases, and translate them into robust technical solutions.

- Propose and implement new platform capabilities with a strong emphasis on measurable performance gains in real-world deployments.

- Participate in daily stand-ups, release planning, and prioritization discussions.

Qualifications and Skills 

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

- 5+ years of professional experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python.

- Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, including cross-compilation, debugging, profiling, and performance tuning.

- Strong hands-on background in diagnosing and optimizing real-world system behavior, including CPU, memory, I/O, networking, boot time, and application latency.

- Experience building or optimizing low-latency video or data-streaming pipelines, ideally on embedded platforms.

- Excellent understanding of software systems that span embedded devices, higher-level applications, and fully integrated products.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, implementation, debugging, and testing.

- Experience with video codecs, GStreamer, RTP/RTSP, or hardware-accelerated media pipelines.

- Solid experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Bash scripting, and systemd.

- Experience with Docker and docker-compose in complex development and deployment environments, as well as qemu.

- Strong debugging and performance analysis skills at both system and application level, combined with a proactive and self-directed working style.

- Proficient in ROS2/DDS-style middleware and experienced with networking across multiple OSI layers, including REST APIs and performance-sensitive communication paths.

- Experience with system integration and interfacing sensors or peripherals, especially via USB and Ethernet.

- Experience working in an agile engineering environment with stand-ups, sprint planning, and shared ownership across teams.

- Bonus: Experience with build systems such as CMake, including improving build performance in large-scale software projects.

Benefits 

- Flexible working hours

- Stock Options

- Generous holiday allowance

- Company pension plan 

- Car parking 

- Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

- Mental health and wellbeing support

- Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion 

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Solutions Consultant
description:
As OpenSpace's Solutions Consultant for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you'll be the technical and commercial partner to our Account Executives. You'll win deals by proving the business value of OpenSpace, get new customers live quickly, and drive the adoption that turns first projects into long-term, growing accounts. You'll work across the whole customer lifecycle, from first demo through renewal, with regular visits to customer offices and job sites across the region.

What you will be doing 

- Owning the technical win with the Account Executive, from discovery and tailored demos through to a signed contract

- Scoping, running and closing out pilots and proofs of value, with clear success criteria agreed with the AE and the customer

- Finding and qualifying expansion opportunities in existing accounts and building pipeline with the AE

- Leading the value and ROI conversation at renewal and expansion, using usage data and customer outcomes to build business cases

- Onboarding new customers: project setup, capture training for field teams and admin training for project managers

- Driving adoption after go-live through usage reviews, project check-ins and value reviews with customer stakeholders

- Answering technical, security and data privacy (GDPR) questions, supporting tenders and RFPs, and advising on integrations such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma)

- Bringing market feedback to the Product team and building German-language enablement material with Marketing

What we are looking for 

- A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture or a related field, or equivalent work experience

- 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a construction technology or AEC software company, or in project or site management at an owner or construction company

- A proven track record in pre-sales, solutions consulting or customer success with shared revenue targets

- Native German and business-fluent English, spoken and written

- Ability to travel regularly to customer offices and job sites across DACH

- A solid understanding of how construction projects run, from preconstruction to handover, including site documentation and progress tracking

- Experience with complex B2B sales cycles, value selling and qualification methods such as MEDDPICC

- Familiarity with construction software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma) and BIM tools

- Reality capture or 360° imaging experience is a plus

- Knowledge of the DACH construction market and its main contractors is a plus

How you like to work 

- Commercially minded: You spot expansion opportunities, build the ROI case and help the AE move deals forward. You can turn usage data into a clear story about customer value.

- A clear communicator: You adapt your message to site managers, project managers and executives, and you explain technical concepts in plain language.

- Organized and independent: You can run several onboardings and pilots at once, and you're comfortable in a small regional team that works closely with colleagues in other countries and time zones.

If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions .

title: Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning
description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform.

We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems.

We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role.

Responsibilities

- Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation.

- Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance.

- Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers.

- Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation.

Requirements

- Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch.

- Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers.

- Demonstrated ability to operate at the frontier of SciML, Universal Differential Equations, Neural ODEs, and other emerging hybrid data-driven/mechanistic paradigms.

- Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD or thesis, published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned.

- Experience in the following fields an advantage but not strictly required:

- The JAX ecosystem: Diffrax, Equinox, Optax, Lineax.

- Plasma, fluid, electromagnetic, or other multiphysics simulation.

- Having led the design of a scientific codebase used by others.

What we offer

- Play a key role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.

- Build cutting-edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.

- Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life.

- Competitive salary and equity compensation and benefits including immigration assistance.

title: Data/ML engineer, fusion data
description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Responsibilities

Requirements

- Hands-on experience building data pipelines for large scientific or industrial time-series data formats (e.g. HDF5, Parquet, Zarr).

- Proficiency in designing, querying and optimizing SQL and noSQL database systems and familiarity with Time Series databases such as TimescaleDB, InfluxDB.

- Experience in applying ML techniques to time series in Python (PyTorch or JAX): sequence models, anomaly and event detection, semi- or weakly-supervised labelling.

- Solid software engineering habits: testing, reproducibility, data versioning are second nature to you.

- Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD thesis and/or published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned. You should be comfortable designing data architectures independently from day 1.

- The following are an advantage but not strictly required:

- Human-in-the-loop labelling tools and workflows.

title: Adviseur Loopbaan en Mobilteit
description:
Als je goed zorgt voor je mensen, zorgen zij goed voor jou. Deze overtuiging van de oprichter van ADG Dienstengroep vormt de basis van Koersmakers. Koersmakers is een nieuw bedrijf dat werkt aan duurzame inzetbaarheid voor vakmensen, zodat zij maximale regie krijgen over het (werkende) leven. Om dit goed in de praktijk te brengen zijn we op zoek naar een adviseur in de regio Amsterdam/Rotterdam, Noord en Oost Nederland

Omschrijving van het team 

Koersmakers is een jong, maar groeiend team van 9 collega’s. De mobiliteitsadviseurs Annemiek, Celine, Wilco, Miranda, Mariëlle, Dana en Inez, begeleiden ieder in hun eigen regio vakmensen in verschillende trajecten: van spoor 2 re-integratie tot (loopbaan)coaching en van gespreksbegeleiding tot leiderschapstrainingen. Zwaantje ondersteunt hen in de dagelijkse operatie en Sterre is kwartiermaker en eindverantwoordelijk voor Koersmakers.

Taken

Wat ga je doen? 

Als adviseur ga jij in de verschillende trajecten de verhalen, doelen en talenten van hun vakmensen naar boven halen. Op dit moment begeleid je hoofdzakelijk medewerkers in een Spoor 2 re-integratie traject. Tegelijkertijd worden we inmiddels ook steeds vaker gevraagd om vakmensen te begeleiden in (loopbaan)-coaching trajecten en bij gespreksbegeleiding. En die beweging naar preventieve dienstverlening omtrent de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen is precies de stap die ze de komende tijd samen met jou willen zetten. 

In de begeleiding van vakmensen maak je gebruik van passende (interesse)testen, waaronder de Predictive Index. Jij zet vervolgens dat wat iemand wil, drijft en kan, om naar concrete acties om de inzetbaarheid van deze vakmensen te vergroten en behouden. Hierbij houd je rekening met de actuele regels tot Wet Verbetering Poortwachter en de verzuimcyclus van het UWV. Daarnaast ondersteun je de leidinggevenden van de verschillende ADG bedrijven hoe zij samen met hen de regie van vakmensen op het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk kunnen brengen. 

Ze vinden het geen probleem als je geen tot weinig ervaring hebt met het gebruik van onze testen.

Vereisten

Wat ze wel belangrijk vinden: 

- Je hebt ervaring met het uitvoeren van Spoor 2 re-integratie trajecten.

- Je vindt het leuk om te werken aan de duurzame inzetbaarheid van hun medewerkers. Vakmensen die werk doen wat vaak niet gezien wordt, juist als het écht goed gedaan wordt. Schoonmaakmedewerkers, onderhoudsmonteurs, hospitality professionals, BOA’s en zorgmedewerkers. Zij houden Nederland draaiend. Zij doen het voor hén.

- Jij zorgt dat de uitvoering van hun dienstverlening (in geval van Spoor 2 re-integratie) voldoet aan de eisen die de verzuimcyclus en de Wet Verbetering Poortwachter stelt.

- Je legt makkelijk contact met andere mensen, ook in onbekende situaties. Je toont interesse in wie zij zijn en kunt een leidende en sturende rol goed afwisselen met een luisterende en afwachtende rol. 

- Je werkt zelfstandig, beschikt over probleemoplossend vermogen en neemt regie over de trajecten die je begeleidt. Je schakelt gemakkelijk met verschillende gesprekspartners en vertaalt doelen naar concrete stappen, ook wanneer de situatie nog niet volledig duidelijk is

- Je werkt gericht toe naar (nieuwe) mogelijkheden voor vakmensen om (weer) inzetbaar te worden en blijven. Je vertaalt doelen en mogelijkheden in concrete afspraken en houdt jezelf, medewerkers en leidinggevenden aan deze afspraken. 

- Jij blijft je, ook bij weerstand of uitdagingen, inspannen om de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen te vergroten of behouden.

- Je werkt precies en zorgvuldig en signaleert bij onvolledigheden en afwijkingen in de begeleiding of rapportages. Hierbij schroom je niet om te benoemen wat je ziet en hoort, durf je kritische vragen te stellen, altijd met het doel om tot oplossingen en mogelijkheden voor inzetbaarheid te komen en altijd met respect voor de ander.

Benefits

- Een jaarcontract voor 24 tot 40 uur

- 27 vakantiedagen op basis van 40 uur

- Een dertiende maand

- Opleidingsmogelijkheden, denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

o De predictive index practitioner 

o Of een andere opleiding die bijdraagt aan de doelstelling van Koersmakers: regie over het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk brengen.

- Een fijne werkplek in Houten of bij een van onze ADG zusjes.

- Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken.

- De kans om echt impact te maken en mee te bouwen aan een nieuw bedrijf

Over Koersmakers 

Koersmakers is een startup van ADG. Een Twents familiebedrijf met ruim 11.000 collega’s dat groot is geworden met en dankzij hun vakmensen op de werkvloer. ADG zet zich in voor vakmensen met waardering en ondersteuning.

Koersmakers gelooft dat dit leidt tot een creatievere en productievere werksfeer, waar innovatieve ideeën kunnen bloeien, betere besluiten worden genomen en talenten volledig tot hun recht kunnen komen.

- Run the certification program end to end, from submissions and review workflows to certificates, with FDEs making the technical call.

- Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.

- Have built enablement or training programs at scale for partners, sellers or technical teams.

- Learn technical products quickly and can explain them to both technical and commercial audiences.

- Can run a program end to end: learning platforms, timelines, stakeholders and reporting.

- Can lead a session or workshop in front of sellers and engineers.

- Have strong instructional design skills: you can turn expert content into clear courses, labs and assessments.

- Enjoy turning repeat work into automations, tools and agents.

- Have excellent communication skills and can adapt your message to different audiences.

Bonus: 

- Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or in professional services for a frontier AI product.

- Hands-on experience building LLM applications or voice and chat agents, and reviewing whether they are ready for production.

- Familiarity with Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks and common integration patterns.

- Telephony experience, such as SIP, Twilio or contact center platforms.

- Experience at a systems integrator, hyperscaler or technology partner.

- Experience with learning platforms such as WorkRamp.

- Proficient in Spanish or Portuguese.

Growth Potential 

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

- Leading a partner enablement team as the academy grows.

- Leading the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value commercial agreements with advertisers, publishers, agencies, technology partners and vendors, including MSAs, SaaS and platform terms, partnership agreements, DPAs and NDAs

- Managing disputes, litigation and third-party information requests such as subpoenas, together with external counsel

- Shaping how Legal uses AI: introducing AI tools and workflows that make the team more efficient, and advising the business on the legal aspects of AI, including the EU AI Act

Skills & Expertise

- Solid M&A experience, including due diligence, transaction documentation and post-closing integration

- Working knowledge of data protection laws such as GDPR, UK GDPR and US state privacy laws is an advantage

- Native or native-level English, with excellent drafting and communication skills and the ability to explain complex legal, technical and business matters clearly to non-lawyers; additional languages such as Spanish, French or Portuguese are a plus

- A keen interest in AI and confidence using AI tools in your daily work, with an eye for how they can make legal work faster and better; knowledge of AI regulation and governance, such as the EU AI Act, is a plus

- A pragmatic, hands-on and open-minded approach with a business-enabling, can-do mindset

- Strong organisation and prioritisation skills: you manage several matters at once, work independently and keep quality high under tight deadlines and constant change; experience with contract management systems, Asana or other legal tools is welcome

- A collaborative team player who builds strong relationships across functions and regions

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Team Agent
description:
About the role 

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Agent team.

We are building a platform for creating, publishing, and executing AI-powered agents that help teams automate complex workflows in financial services. The Agents team owns the agent execution runtime, tool orchestration, and platform infrastructure that makes this possible, including the conversational copilot experiences built on top of it across the product.

We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to help build and ship production features across this entire stack, from the agent runtime and tool orchestration layer in the backend, to the conversational copilot experiences users interact with every day. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to real product impact from day one, and grow your skills in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

What You'll Do 

- Build and ship features end-to-end for Taktile's AI agent platform: backend in Python (FastAPI) on AWS serverless infrastructure, and frontend in React and TypeScript.

- Build conversational copilot experiences end to end: chat UI components, streaming responses, rich in-chat interactions, and human-in-the-loop approvals.

- Improve how agents run, how they connect to external tools, and how they behave when something goes wrong.

- Own your work end-to-end: collaborate on scope, implement, test, release, and iterate based on real usage and customer feedback.

- Use leading-edge AI tools (e.g. Claude) on a daily basis to move faster, improve quality, and build AI-native capabilities where it makes sense.

- Review pull requests with depth, improve test coverage and CI/CD, and raise the bar on reliability and engineering excellence.

- Engage actively in team rituals such as daily syncs, planning sessions, demos, and technical deep-dive discussions.

- Grow as an individual and accelerate your career by learning from experienced team members, contributing to a foundational layer of the product, and joining cross-team learning groups.

- For career growth at Taktile, this role will involve daytime ops duty and at some point joining an on-call rotation, so you need to have passion for owning systems end to end and grow your DevSecOps skills as well.

Team's tech stack 

- Backend: Python (FastAPI, Pydantic)

- Frontend: React, TypeScript

- Data: DynamoDB, Postgres

- Cloud: AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway)

- AI: LLM orchestration, tool-use frameworks, streaming execution

Requirements 

- Strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for simplicity and precision.

- Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential as we operate in an hybrid environment requiring clear and effective communication. Strong English skills are also crucial to efficiently interacting with AI.

- Prior industry experience building full-stack web applications (this is not an entry-level position).

- Proficiency with React and TypeScript, and experience building rich, interactive user interfaces.

- Experience with Python back-end development, building and operating RESTful APIs, and working with databases.

- Experience integrating into AWS or similar cloud providers.

Nice but not required 

- Experience building chat or conversational UIs, real-time/streaming interfaces, or data visualization.

- FastAPI and Pydantic experience.

- DynamoDB or Postgres, SQLAlchemy.

- Exposure to LLM application development, agent frameworks, MCP, or building developer tools.

- Prior ops or on-call experience.

- Experience with distributed systems, async task processing, or observability tooling (tracing, metrics, logging).

Our Offer 

- Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

- Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

- Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

- Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

- Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

- Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance 

- We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

- We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us 

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents.

With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding.

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo.

With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com .

About Your Employment . Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process. 

Your Privacy . Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references. 

How we use your data: We process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you about the recruitment process, comply with legal obligations (such as right-to-work verification), and, with your consent, to consider you for future opportunities. 

Legal basis (EU/UK applicants): We rely on (i) pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR/UK GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)), (ii) legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)), and (iii) our legitimate interest in evaluating candidates (Art. 6(1)(f)).

Your rights: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent. 

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review.

title: Senior MarTech Product Manager (d/f/m)
description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Role summary

You own the marketing-technology layer behind Taxfix's growth: the conversion signals that tell ad networks who converted, the customer data that powers CRM, the consent flows that decide what we may share and with whom, and the referral program, one of the growth mechanics the team owns end to end. This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. You set direction for a small engineering team (a tech lead plus 3–4 engineers, two-week sprints) that supports four products across three markets, with Paid Acquisition, CRM, Brand and Creative as internal customers. A typical week mixes debugging a missing ad-network event, scoping a referral reward, settling a data-sharing question with Legal, and explaining trade-offs to leadership. All work, including across markets, happens in English; German is not required.

What you'll do

- Own conversion-signal engineering for paid acquisition: client-side and server-to-server events into Singular, Firebase/GA4, Google Ads and TikTok, including synthetic events, revenue values and predicted-LTV signals.

- Run the referral program as a product: reward mechanics, eligibility and fraud rules, voucher infrastructure (Voucherify), the in-app voucher wallet, entry points, and the experiments that tune them.

- Grow push and marketing-consent opt-in through permission primers, iOS/Android OS permission flows and notification preferences.

- Keep CRM data trustworthy: Braze attributes and events, Snowflake-to-Braze syncs, event-loss monitoring, and moving legacy messaging (SendGrid, Firebase) onto Braze.

- Turn consent and privacy requirements into product behaviour, and work with Legal on what data can go to which partner.

- Adapt tracking, CRM attributes and attribution to company launches, such as new subscription pricing tiers, without breaking downstream campaigns or reporting.

- Turn stakeholder requests, support escalations and spike findings into tickets engineers can start on, and decide what goes into the sprint.

- Weigh roadmap work against platform upkeep: pipeline migrations, security fixes, end-of-life SDKs.

- Design A/B tests (Eppo) and read the results for marketing and consent opt-s, and referral changes.

- Report progress, risks and trade-offs in writing to marketing leadership, including VP and C-level.

Must-have skills and experience

- Several years as a product manager owning martech, growth infrastructure or data products, setting your own roadmap with senior stakeholders.

- Hands-on mobile and web attribution: an MMP (Singular or comparable), server-to-server events, and ad-network conversion setups (Google Ads, TikTok).

- Event-tracking depth: you can define an event schema, write a tracking spec, and trace a missing or duplicated event through Segment, Google Tag Manager and the receiving platform.

- CRM data platforms, ideally Braze: custom attributes, event-triggered segmentation, data ingestion and sync quality.

- Working knowledge of EU consent and privacy: GDPR, consent mode, iOS App Tracking Transparency, and how push permissions behave on iOS and Android.

- Experimentation: framing hypotheses, choosing and configuring metrics, judging when a result is real.

- Precise writing: specs that engineers (and AI coding agents) can start on without a meeting, and concise updates and decision memos for leadership.

- Enough technical fluency to work through trade-offs with engineers across mobile apps (React Native), backend services and data pipelines, and to triage production incidents.

Nice to have

- Performance marketing experience with the main app and web acquisition channels (e.g. Google Ads, TikTok).

- Referral, loyalty or voucher programs; Voucherify specifically.

- Predicted-LTV or value-based bidding signals (e.g. Churney).

- Deep linking and deferred deep linking across ad networks.

- AI-driven CRM orchestration (Aampe) or creative asset tooling (Frontify, AI creative tagging).

- Building AI agents or automation for product and engineering workflows.

- Querying data yourself in SQL (Snowflake), and familiarity with dbt and Airflow.

Why Taxfix? 

- A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

- Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

- A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

- Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, that went from $0 to $15M ARR in 18 months, with a 100+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

About the role

Peec AI is building the data plane for AI visibility: millions of chats, scrapes, citations, sources, model responses, and customer-facing insights running through a fast-moving backend.

This role is for an engineer who wants to own the systems behind that. You will not just add endpoints or close tickets. You will make our scraping, chat-processing, source-ingestion, and analytics infrastructure more reliable, cheaper, faster, and easier for the rest of the team to reason about.

The best fit looks like someone who can debug a provider outage in the morning, design a better queueing model before lunch, ship a TypeScript service change in the afternoon, and write the postmortem or follow-up ticket clearly enough that the next engineer immediately knows what to do.

We are especially interested in people who have built or operated systems with real constraints: rate limits, flaky third-party APIs, queues, webhooks, retries, distributed locks, data migrations, observability gaps, customer pressure, and cost ceilings.

What we’re looking for

- 5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering experience in a production environment.

- Deep hands-on TypeScript experience. We run TypeScript services on Bun, and we care about people who can design clean, reliable backend systems rather than only write application code.

- Strong understanding of queues, workers, retries, rate limits, idempotency, distributed locks, webhooks, and failure handling.

- Experience operating systems under real production pressure: incidents, provider outages, customer escalations, noisy alerts, slow dependencies, and incomplete data.

- Comfort with cloud-native infrastructure. Our stack includes GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Redis, Postgres, Firestore, ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

- Ability to debug across layers: application code, logs, metrics, queues, provider APIs, databases, network behaviour, and deployment state.

- Product-minded judgement. You can separate internal detail from customer-safe explanation, and you understand when a “small infra change” has customer, security, or cost implications.

- High ownership and low ego. We want people who take responsibility for ambiguous systems, ask sharp questions, and make the team better through clear thinking and kindness.

- A bias toward durable fixes. You do not stop at “restart the pod” if the real issue is retry amplification, missing backpressure, an unsafe parser assumption, or a provider limit we do not model.

Tech stack

- Languages: TypeScript, Python

- Runtime/frameworks: Bun, Elysia, Node-compatible services

- Cloud/infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, Firebase/Firestore, Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ

- Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, structured logging

- Product/data domain: LLM chats, AI search, source scraping, citation extraction, provider integrations, customer-facing analytics

- AI/model providers: OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode / AI Overview, plus scraping/provider APIs around them

- The most beautiful office space and work environment in Berlin

- Arbeitsweise: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und arbeitest gleichzeitig eng mit anderen zusammen. Du wechselst zwischen Strategie und Umsetzung, ohne eines von beidem aus dem Blick zu verlieren.

- Schreiben: Du schreibst gut und gerne selbst. Aus einem technischen Gespräch mit einem Engineer machst du eine Case Study oder Website-Copy, die Einkäufer:innen in der Industrie verstehen.

- Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.

Vorteile

- Marketing von Grund auf: Es gibt kein Playbook und keine Altlasten. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit den Gründern, wie Cell Labs an den Markt geht, und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit direkt in der Pipeline.

- Alles unter einem Dach: Büro, Werkstatt und Teststände liegen im selben Gebäude in Kreuzberg. Wenn du eine Story für eine Case Study brauchst oder den Roboter in Aktion sehen willst, ist der Engineer ein paar Schritte entfernt, kein Ticket.

- Room to Fail & Grow: Bezahlte Lernzeit mit persönlichem Budget für Kurse, Marketing-Konferenzen und die Tools, die du brauchst. Du bekommst Raum, Neues auszuprobieren, und bringst ein Produkt an den Markt, das bisher kaum jemand gesehen hat.

- Benefits: Ein Leistungspaket, das du dir selbst zusammenstellst und das Mobilität, Gesundheit, Ernährung oder Fitness abdeckt. Dazu gibt’s einen zusätzlichen bezahlten freien Tag im Jahr für ehrenamtliches Engagement oder ein Projekt, das dir am Herzen liegt.

Bewerbung 

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu einer Kampagne oder einem Launch, den du verantwortet hast. Was war das Ziel, was hast du getan, was kam dabei heraus? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Der Prozess: Intro Call, Deep Dive in deine bisherige Arbeit, Besuch bei uns mit einer kleinen Case Study, Angebot.

Wir bauen Roboter für alle, deshalb wollen wir ein Team, das das abbildet. Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten ein und freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die in Marketing und Tech unterrepräsentiert sind. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, aber denkst, das ist dein Job: bewirb dich.

title: iOS Engineer - Design System
description:
About the team: 

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

What you'll do: 

- Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem

- Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful

- Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type

- Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation

- Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development

- Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability

- Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

You'll be a great fit for this role if you: 

- Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications

- Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each

- Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable

- Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought

- Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation

- Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team

- Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment

- Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

Why you should join SumUp: 

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which you can be used to attend conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp 

We believe in the everyday hero.

Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating tools that help them run their businesses. With a founder's mentality and a 'team-first' attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love. 

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. 

SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate 

Job Application Tip 

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.
