description:
DACH Enterprise Account Executive – SAP Ecosystem & Digital Transformation (m/f/d) 

Position Summary: 

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, reporting to the VP of Global GTM. We are seeking an elite, high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition across top-tier accounts. Combining large-enterprise sophistication with an aggressive, entrepreneurial hunting mindset, you will architect transformational security deals, engage C-level stakeholders, and position business resilience for the world's most mission-critical ERP environments.

Key Responsibilities 

Drive Strategic Revenue: Own the full sales lifecycle for Global 2000 accounts, positioning the Onapsis Platform as the essential security layer for SAP and Business Critical Applications. 

The SAP "Triple Threat": 

- Direct Sales: Manage complex, high-value "land and expand" cycles.

- SAP Co-Sell: Partner with SAP Account Executives (AEs) and Enterprise Architects to attach Onapsis to S/4HANA and RISE migrations.

- GSI Alignment: Orchestrate go-to-market strategies with Global Systems Integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, PwC) who are leading the world's largest SAP transformations.

C-Suite Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs and CIOs, translating technical vulnerabilities into business risks (e.g., SOX compliance, financial downtime, and data integrity).

Territory Orchestration: Develop and execute an annual territory plan focused on "White Space" analysis within the SAP installed base.

Forecast Accuracy: Maintain a high level of "Sales Hygiene" within CRM, delivering predictable weekly and monthly forecasts aligned with SAP's rigorous reporting standards.

Required Skills/Experience: 

- Proven Enterprise Track Record: 7–10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a proven history of selling complex software solutions within the SAP ecosystem (either at SAP or a top-tier partner).

- Cloud Transformation Expert: Deep understanding of the RISE with SAP framework, Clean Core strategy, and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) .

- Consistent High Achiever: Consistent record of quota over-achievement, regularly closing seven-figure ARR deals across Global 2000 accounts with complex buying committees.

- Alliance Savvy: Demonstrated success in "partner-first" selling, particularly with GSIs and SAP's regional field teams.

- Communication: Exceptional executive presence; ability to move seamlessly from a technical discussion with a Basis Lead to a strategic ROI pitch with a CFO.

- Ability to travel: We believe that our business is a people business and that trust is built in person. Between 25-50% travel required. 

Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proactive self-starter with the drive to build a territory from scratch and take full ownership of business growth.Languages: Professional fluency in both German and English (written and spoken). 

What You will get: 

- You can expect a job with responsible tasks and creative opportunities, an attractive salary and extensive benefits (including JobRad, Focus Friday and much more).

- You have flexible working hours with us. In addition, you can work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement.

- We support our employees with 5 fully paid sick days per child and subsidize childcare up to primary school age.

- In addition to an individual onboarding and buddy program, we offer comprehensive training opportunities and english language classes.

- We offer 30 days of paid vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek) for optimal work-life balance.

- Furthermore, you can expect an innovative and attractive workplace with flat hierarchies and respectful and solution-oriented communication.

- Equity in a late-stage, high-growth leader backed by top-tier VC/PE firms.

- The chance to represent the only cybersecurity solution endorsed by SAP.

About Onapsis: 

Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. The Onapsis Platform delivers vulnerability management, change assurance, and continuous compliance for business applications from leading vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and others. The Onapsis Platform is powered by the Onapsis Research Labs, the team responsible for the discovery and mitigation of more than 1,000 zero-day vulnerabilities in business applications.

Onapsis is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Dallas, TX, Heidelberg, Germany, Bucharest, Romania, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, and proudly serves hundreds of the world's leading brands, including close to 30% of the Forbes Global 100, six of the top 10 automotive companies, five of the top 10 chemical companies, four of the top 10 technology companies, and three of the top 10 oil and gas companies.

title: Account Director, Central Banks & Regulators (EMEA)
description:

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. TRM helps governments and financial institutions detect and disrupt illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to central banks, financial regulators and financial intelligence units across EMEA. You will own the relationships and the revenue in a territory where digital asset supervision is growing fast, setting account strategy and closing six- and seven-figure deals with institutions that have long, careful buying processes. What makes this seat unusual is the chance to shape how TRM serves supervisors as MiCA and the EU AML package reshape their work.

The impact you will have: 

- Map your territory’s central banks, supervisors and FIUs, using AI tools to identify budget holders, decision-makers, champions and regulatory triggers so your first outreach reaches the right person.

- Win six- and seven-figure deals by turning each institution’s supervisory and enforcement challenges into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans that you sharpen with your own judgment.

- Build and maintain 3x qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, regional events and campaigns with Marketing, and measure what converts.

- Navigate tenders, frameworks and call-offs with Solutions Architecture, Legal and Deal Desk, so each response is accurate and on time.

- Grow live customers through renewals, expansion and referrals, using AI summaries of usage and call notes to spot expansion signals early.

- Bring supervisory and customer insight back to Policy, Product and Marketing so the next release reflects how regulators in your region work.

What we’re looking for: 

- 6+ years selling SaaS, data intelligence or investigative solutions into central banks, financial regulators, FIUs or comparable government accounts in EMEA.

- A record of closing six- and seven-figure deals and meeting quota across long, multi-stakeholder cycles.

- Existing relationships within EMEA central banks, supervisors or FIUs, and credibility with senior officials.

- Working knowledge of MiCA, the EU AML framework and how public sector buyers procure.

- Hands-on use of AI for account research, planning and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.

- Credible, clear communication with senior executives, in person and virtually, and a knack for storytelling.

- Fluent English; additional European languages are a plus.

- Based in France, Belgium, Spain, Netherlands, willingness to travel regularly across the region. 

About the Team: 

- TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director real ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.

- The team is fast-paced, positive and collaborative, with shared pipeline insight and open sharing of what works.

- The work is hard in a useful way: senior public sector buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a category that is new to many supervisors.

- You will work with Partnerships, Legal, Marketing, Policy and Product, who move quickly to back your deals.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position: 

- Within your first 30 days, you profile and stack-rank every central bank, regulator and FIU in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.

- When a regulator sends an urgent request late on a Friday for a same-day conversation and demo, you and TRM’s Solutions team make it happen that day.

- When a government RFx lands with only a few days to respond, you rally Solutions Architecture and Deal Desk to deliver a high-quality response on time.

Team Operating Rhythms: 

- Distributed, not distant: the team works across UK and CET time zones, with occasional later calls for US-EMEA opportunities.

- Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.

- Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and fortnightly pod calls.

- Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

Required online and collaboration hours: 

- Schedule: UK and CET core hours, with flexibility for occasional US-EMEA calls. 

Application Instructions 

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM 

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

- Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

- Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

- First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

- Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

- References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

- Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

- Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

AI Fluency at TRM 

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

- Accelerate repeatable workflows

- Structure and solve problems

- Improve output quality

- Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM 

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

- Priorities and targets to change quickly

- Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

- A high level of personal ownership and accountability

- Close collaboration across teams and functions

- Frequent, high-touch communication

- Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

- A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 

Leadership Principles 

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

- Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

- Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

- Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

- Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.

- Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

title: Staff Product Manager - Platform
description:
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. At Staff level, your scope follows the problem, across teams and over time into product-wide questions.

The problem space: Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces. 

How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it?

About Nelly 

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will: 

- Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money

- Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany

- Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start

- Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do

- Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs

What you'll bring: 

- Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including well beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk

- Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward

- Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation

- Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data models, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to senior engineers

- You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly, so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product

- 7+ years of product management experience

Even better if you have: 

- Built and shipped AI products

- Worked on data platforms or data products

- Built B2B SaaS in healthcare or another regulated industry

- Professional German language knowledge

Our Interview Process: 

- Introduction to Nelly with TA

- Product craft interview with our Product manager

- Case study interview with Director of Product

- Onsite interview with hiring manager and stakeholders

What we offer: 

- The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it.

- Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still.

- A yearly learning and development budget , plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment in your learning. 

- A front row seat while we build something big. We are building the financial operating system for European healthcare, with AI woven into how we build, sell and support. Real scope, real impact.

- Deutschlandticket or Swapfiets membership, so you get around the city fast.

- Urban Sports Club membership , for sport and balance.

- Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup. 

- Up to 4 weeks of workation. 

- A dog friendly office with great vibes and a team that is fun to work with.

We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
About Andercore 

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

- Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

- Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

- 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

- $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role 

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times. 

As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you

Tech stack 

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of.

What you will do 

- Set the technical direction across teams: define the target architecture, write the RFCs behind big decisions, and make sure teams build towards the same picture. 

- Lead the hardest technical work yourself, from design to production, instead of only advising on it. 

- Shape the carve-out of our transaction core from Salesforce into a modern, modular core system, with a migration path that never disrupts daily trading. 

- Make reliability, security and observability part of how we build: monitoring, alerting, incident response and postmortems that lead to real changes. 

- Design how our AI agents act safely on money-touching paths, with evaluations, guardrails, audit trails and human review where it matters. 

- Set standards for correctness and data integrity, including idempotency, validation and testing, together with QA. 

- Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing and direct feedback, and help us hire by defining what great engineering looks like at Andercore.

In your first six months, you might 

- Design the architecture of our pricing engine so it scales with a growing assortment and more markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds. 

- Lay out the target architecture and first steps for moving our transaction core off Salesforce.

- Build the observability and incident setup that lets us catch problems before customers or colleagues notice them

What you bring 

- At least 8 years of experience building and running software in production, including systems where errors cost real money. 

- Deep backend expertise at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot. 

- A track record of setting architecture across several teams, through influence rather than a management title. 

- Experience designing transactional, distributed and event-driven systems, with a strong focus on correctness, failure modes and performance. 

- Hands-on depth in reliability, security and observability, and experience leading incidents and postmortems. 

- Experience in a fast-growing company, and a track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones. 

- AI is part of your daily work. Experience building or evaluating AI agents in production is a strong plus. 

- Experience with re-platforming or carving out systems from a platform like Salesforce or an ERP is a plus

Practical details 

- Location: Berlin, hybrid

- Working language: English

- A learning budget for your development

- Start date: As soon as possible

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: Growth Consultant | Deutsch C2
description:
Growth Consultant (m/w/d), Account Management für 30 bis 40 B2B Tech Kunden in Berlin

Die meisten Account-Management-Jobs heißen Beratung und bestehen am Ende aus Reporting-Decks und Ticket-Pingpong. Hier ist es umgekehrt: Die Umsetzung macht das Team, du berätst.

Unser Kunde ist eine AI-first GTM Agentur aus Berlin Mitte. Seit 2024 auf über 5 Mio. EUR ARR und 30+ Leute gewachsen, mit 200+ B2B Tech Kunden, von der Mobility-App über einen Schweizer Telko-Konzern bis zum Bildungsverlag. Zuletzt kam in einem einzigen Monat über 1 Mio. EUR neuer ARR dazu.

Jeder dieser Kunden braucht jemanden, der ihn hält und ausbaut. Genau dafür ist dieser Seat da.

Das Paket: 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention, Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage Office und 2 Tage remote.

Tasks

- Du führst dein eigenes Portfolio aus ca. 30 bis 40 Accounts und sitzt alle zwei Wochen mit Geschäftsführern und Entscheidern im Termin.

- Deine Kunden sind B2B Software- und Tech-Firmen, die über Google, LinkedIn, Meta und signalbasiertes Outbound ihre Pipeline aufbauen. Insgesamt laufen jeden Monat sechsstellige Budgets in Paid Search und Paid Social über die Agentur.

- Der typische Moment: Ein Geschäftsführer, der viel Geld in Ads und Outbound steckt, fragt dich, warum seine Leads teurer geworden sind und ob er das Budget kürzen soll. Du hast die Antwort und den nächsten Schritt.

- Beratung statt Operatives: Kampagnen bauen die GTM- und Performance-Marketing-Teams. Du entscheidest mit dem Kunden, was als Nächstes gebaut wird.

- Upsell und Retention sind dein Hebel: neuer Kanal, mehr Budget, Verlängerung. Dein Spielfeld ist das bestehende Portfolio.

- Du liest die Zahlen deiner Accounts (Leads, Cost per Lead, Pipeline) und siehst ein Abwanderungsrisiko, bevor der Kunde es ausspricht.

Requirements

- Ein paar Jahre B2B mit echter, eigener Kundenverantwortung. Ob als Account Manager, BDM, kommerzielles Customer Success, AE mit Bestandskunden oder Founder’s Associate, der Titel ist egal. Interne Koordination oder reines Projektmanagement zählt hier nicht.

- Du erzählst deinen Track Record in Zahlen: wie viele Accounts, welche Retention, wie viel Upsell-Volumen.

- Wenn dir ein Geschäftsführer im Call sagt, die Leads taugen nichts und er überlegt zu kündigen, gehst du in die Daten statt in die Defensive und kommst mit einem Plan raus.

- Du hältst 30+ Kunden parallel auf dem Schirm, ohne dass einer durchrutscht, und baust dir dafür dein eigenes System.

- Du brauchst niemanden, der dir den Tag plant. Du siehst die Lücke und schließt sie.

- Idealerweise hast du Outbound, Lead Gen oder B2B-Akquise schon selbst gemacht. Pluspunkte: Google oder LinkedIn Ads, CRM, Agentur-, Consulting- oder Startup-Background.

- Fix: Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, gutes Englisch, Festanstellung in Vollzeit, 3 Tage pro Woche im Berliner Office (der erste Monat komplett vor Ort).

- Early Career bis Mid. Gesucht ist Hunger, nicht Seniorität: Wer seit Jahren Senior Advisory macht, wird hier nicht glücklich. Ein Abschluss oder ein großes Logo im Lebenslauf sind nicht das Tor, deine Zahlen schon.

Benefits

- 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention. Du verdienst also auch daran, dass Kunden bleiben, nicht nur an neuen Deals. 

- Perspektive: Die Agentur sucht explizit Leute, die Experten- oder Führungsverantwortung übernehmen wollen. 

- Lernkurve: Alle zwei Wochen sitzt du mit Geschäftsführern aus 30 bis 40 verschiedenen B2B Tech Firmen am Tisch. Nach 12 Monaten kannst du einem GF sagen, welcher Kanal sich für sein Geschäftsmodell rechnet und welcher nicht.

- 1:1 Coaching mit erfahrenen Leuten ab Tag 1.

- Office in Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage vor Ort und 2 remote, MacBook und eigener Platz mit Bildschirm.

- Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club M, regelmäßige Team-Abende.

- Start: ASAP

Closing

Klingt nach dir? Die Bewerbung dauert zwei Minuten, kein Motivationsschreiben.

So läuft’s: Bewerbung ➝ Talent Call mit uns ➝ 10 Min Kennenlernen beim Kunden ➝ 30 bis 45 Min Deep Dive ➝ ca. 90 Min vor Ort mit den Gründern und dem Team ➝ Rückmeldung innerhalb von 2 Tagen.

Warum über GENZ4GTM: Vor jedem Kundengespräch bekommst du von uns ein Cheatsheet, nach jeder Runde ehrliches Feedback, und mit einer Bewerbung matchen wir dich auf mehrere passende Rollen.

title: Robotics Engineer - Integration & Control (m/f/d)
description:
About Prefiro

Asparagus cost up to 25 euros per kilo this season! That’s because, like most of the produce on the shelf, it’s harvested exclusively by hand. Here at Prefiro, we’re the first to automate these processes! We use artificial intelligence, and robotics to bring next-generation agricultural equipment to the field.

Are you excited about applying new technologies in real-world conditions, solving interesting and varied problems, and seeing firsthand the impact your ideas have?

Then join our growing team and help us deliver the first autonomous asparagus harvester to farms.

Your responsibilities

- Integrate robots and IO into the robotics stack – from startup and service to error handling and recovery.

- Work on MPC-based trajectory planning and optimal control: from approach to implementation on the robot in real time.

- Help optimize cycle times in real-world applications

- Scale the stack from one robot module to several per machine: networking, robot setup and calibration.

- Tune the robot computers for real-time control: Docker, CPU pinning, ROS 2 scheduling and multithreading.

- Build remote access, data collection and robotics CI/CD (e.g. rosbag-playback tests) to improve the robots with real field data.

- Review code, contribute to architecture decisions and debug the stack as a team.

- Run the robots during pre-season field tests and the harvest season.

What you bring

- Master's Degree in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.

- At least 2 years of professional experience in robotics, including hands-on work with real robots (not only simulation).

- Strong modern C++ (C++17) and Python 3.

- Hands-on experience with ROS 2 (ideally Jazzy): nodes, lifecycle nodes, executors, QoS, launch files.

- Experience with trajectory controllers and trajectory planning.

- Solid grounding in robot kinematics and dynamics (URDF, Pinocchio or similar).

- Proven experience with optimal control and model predictive control for trajectory planning; reinforcement learning is a plus.

- Comfortable with CMake/colcon builds and Git on Linux.

- Experience with real-time robot control and an understanding of soft real-time constraints on Linux (scheduling, latency, threading).

- Fluent English , our working language.

Nice to have

- Industrial arms, especially Denso SCARA (b-CAP, RC8) or Universal Robots.

- Optimal-control frameworks such as acados or CasADi; control barrier functions.

- MoveIt 2 or Ruckig for motion planning.

- Docker, GitLab CI and automated testing (GoogleTest, launch_testing).

- DDS or Zenoh tuning and multi-robot setups.

- Debugging tools such as RViz, Foxglove, PlotJuggler or Nsight Systems.

- Field deployment with systemd, tmux and shell scripting.

- Basic German.

What we offer

- Real fields from your first season. Your code runs on our machines on farms in Germany.

- Short way from code to robot. New ideas usually run on the real machine within a few days.

- A problem worth solving. Green asparagus is still harvested entirely by hand.

- A small, motivated team that gets a lot done together. When you join, we're 8 full-time, plus 2 interns and a working student.

- Open culture, flat hierarchies. We are still early, so your opinion counts in technical decisions.

- Lunch and coffee together in the kitchen in our hall.

- Employee stock options. 

How to apply

Send your CV and a few lines on a robotics project you built on real hardware (links to code welcome) via the "Apply now" button. Please include your earliest start date, salary expectations and vegetable you want to automate next.

Join our mission, join Doctolib!

Doctolib is looking for you as a Working Student in IT Asset & Stock Management to support our IT team at our office in Berlin .

- How on-site IT support contributes to a smooth employee experience

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer (x/f/m)
description:
Your Impact 

We are looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our SRE team dedicated to platform reliability within Platform Engineering.

Your mission will be to act as a technical leader driving Doctolib's reliability and scalability at a European scale, ensuring our platform remains reliable, debuggable, and resilient across infrastructure, observability, and cross-cutting reliability initiatives. You will play a pivotal role in a team driving reliability standards across 170+ applications, contributing directly to supporting 520,000 health professionals and 90 million patients in their daily healthcare journey.

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure, developer experience, and product engineering. You'll act as a technical leader and strategic partner to SREs, software engineers, and product teams, guiding decisions, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-cutting initiatives that elevate our operational maturity.

What you'll do 

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Lead large-scale cross-cutting reliability initiatives across the platform, spanning infrastructure automation, observability, and incident management

- Identify and drive improvements to incident detection, response, and postmortem analysis capabilities

- Define and evolve SLOs, error budgets, and alerting standards across multiple product teams

- Take part in the on-call rotation, and actively contribute to improving our on-call experience by refining alerting, reducing noise, and ensuring actionable telemetry

- Serve as a mentor and technical coach to senior engineers, helping elevate the craft of reliability engineering across the company

- Influence strategic decisions by providing technical guidance to leadership and representing reliability engineering in architectural reviews and platform discussions

- Partner with software engineering teams to embed reliability practices early in the development lifecycle

Who you are 

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you: 

- Have extensive experience (8+ years) in SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles within a large-scale, multi-team production environment

- Have proven experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

- Have strong experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, Kubernetes is a must, its deployment and scaling strategies ecosystem

- Have implemented and operated SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets in production

- Have experience managing on-call rotations and leading incident response in high-stakes environments

- Have a strong systems engineering background with fluency in at least one backend programming language (e.g., Go, Python, Ruby)

- Have a proven ability to lead through influence: setting technical direction, driving consensus, and mentoring engineers across teams

- Are comfortable balancing long-term architecture work with fast, iterative improvements

- Have clear, concise communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to drive alignment in ambiguous environments

- Partner with feature teams to accelerate their production readiness, providing hands-on guidance on reliability best practices, launch reviews, and operational standards before go-live

- Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you: 

- Have deep expertise in observability tooling and architecture (logging, tracing, metrics)

- Have experience designing and operating high-scale telemetry pipelines and working with developers to improve instrumentation quality

- Appreciate working in regulated environments, healthcare, fintech, or similar; at Doctolib, data privacy and compliance are part of every engineering decision

- Care about reliability enablement, golden paths, runbooks, shared libraries

Life at Doctolib Tech 

- Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

- Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

- We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here .

- A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib

- 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)

- Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

- Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz

- Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)

- Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

- Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club

- A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode

- Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit

- For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

- Technical SRE Interview

- Behavioral Interview

description:
ABOUT QUINCE 

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE 

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

- Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 

- Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Returns Manager to own end-to-end reverse logistics performance across our UK and EU operations. From forecasting incoming volume through grading, refunds, fraud prevention, and resale, you'll build a returns operation that's fast, accurate, and cost-efficient — while turning returned inventory back into recovered value. This is a hands-on role for someone who can dig into root causes, manage partners and carriers, and build the reporting to prove it's working.

What You'll Do

Returns Forecasting & Planning 

- Build and maintain returns volume forecasting models across UK and EU markets, factoring in seasonality, backlog, promotions, and category-level return patterns

- Translate forecasts into staffing, processing capacity, and warehouse space plans for returns operations

- Monitor returns rate trends and flag volume shifts to inventory, finance, and merchandising teams

Customer Refunds 

- Oversee timely, accurate refund processing in line with UK and EU consumer rights regulations

- Audit warehouse/QRC staff on grading standards and quality checks

- Partner with customer service and finance to resolve refund discrepancies and disputes

- Track refund turnaround time against SLA and resolve bottlenecks in the refund workflow

Fraud Detection & Prevention 

- Build and refine fraud detection processes for returns abuse (wardrobing, serial returners, empty-box claims, item-not-as-described fraud)

- Partner with risk and customer service teams to develop fraud rules/flags and investigate high-risk cases

- Balance fraud prevention with customer experience, avoiding over-blocking of legitimate returns

Returns Root Cause & Logistics Feedback 

- Track and categorize return reasons, with particular focus on logistics-driven returns (damaged in transit, wrong item shipped, late or failed delivery, packaging failure)

- Partner with warehouse, supply chain, and carrier teams to reduce logistics-driven returns through root cause analysis and corrective action

- Present return reason trends to leadership to inform packaging, product, and logistics improvements

Returns Resale & Recommerce 

- Manage resale/recommerce channels for graded inventory (open-box, refurbished, clearance, secondary market and liquidation partners)

- Maximize recovery value on returned inventory while minimizing time-to-resale

- Build and manage relationships with resale/liquidation partners and evaluate new recommerce channels across UK and EU markets

Reverse Logistics & Carrier Management 

- Negotiate rates and service levels with carriers for return shipments across UK and EU markets

- Manage carrier performance for return pickups, label generation, and inbound transit times

- Evaluate and roll out returns-specific shipping options (paperless returns, drop-off points, pickup services) to reduce cost and improve the customer experience

SLA & Performance Management 

- Define and manage SLAs across the returns lifecycle — receipt to grading, grading to disposition, refund turnaround, and time-to-resale

- Monitor 3PL and warehouse partner performance against returns SLAs; escalate and resolve issues as needed

- Build reporting and dashboards to track returns KPIs and turn data into actionable recommendations for leadership

Cross-Functional & Compliance 

- Partner with customer service, supply chain, finance, and merchandising to align returns operations with broader business goals

- Ensure returns operations comply with UK and EU consumer protection, distance selling, and VAT/duty rules (including treatment of re-imported goods and refund-related VAT adjustments)

- Stay current on evolving returns-related regulation across UK and EU markets

What You'll Bring

Required 

- 5–8+ years managing returns or reverse logistics operations in a high-volume ecommerce or retail environment, ideally across UK and EU markets

- Experience building returns forecasting and capacity planning models

- Solid understanding of UK and EU consumer rights, refund, and distance-selling regulations

- Experience designing or managing returns fraud detection and prevention programs

- Track record reducing logistics-driven returns through root cause analysis and cross-functional fixes

- Experience managing return resale, refurbishment, or liquidation channels

- Carrier negotiation experience for reverse logistics/return shipping

- Strong SLA and KPI management skills, with reporting experience (Excel, SQL, or BI tools)

- Hands-on experience with WMS/OMS returns modules

- Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills

Preferred 

- Experience in DTC, fashion/apparel, or other high-return-rate ecommerce categories

- Familiarity with recommerce or liquidation platforms and partners

- Experience operating across multiple EU countries and languages

- Background in fraud/risk analytics

- Experience managing reverse logistics SLAs with UK/EU carriers (e.g., Royal Mail, Evri, DPD, DHL, GLS)

WHY QUINCE? 

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

title: Data Scientist (Measurement & Signal Processing) (f/m/d)
description:
Description 

QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question.

This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.

Who we are 

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds? 

Picture this: 

- Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

- Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

- Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

- An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us? 

- You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

- From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

- Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

- You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible! 

What will you do 

- Build the checks, from raw quantum sensor signal to field map, that tell a trustworthy measurement from a measurement or reconstruction artifact, on lab and customer data alike.

- Trace a failed check to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not.

- Keep the catalogue of known artifacts and the set of reference measurements that make every new verdict faster and more defensible.

- Validate the team's evaluation methods against simulation and reference measurements before they go into daily use.

- Give our Applications Engineers and the team a clear verdict on each measurement, and feed what breaks back into the next generation of the QDm.

What is expected of you 

- 3+ years of professional experience outside academia applying data science to measurement or imaging data from physical instruments.

- A degree in physics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics or a related discipline; a PhD is welcome, not required.

- Solid statistics and signal or image processing: you ask where a signal comes from, tell it from noise and systematics, and show it with numbers.

- Fluency in Python and the scientific stack, with version control and tests as a habit.

- AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own.

- Comfortable operating our systems in the lab when your analysis needs data.

- Fluent English; German is an advantage, not a requirement. On-site in Munich.

Experience with magnetic or electromagnetic measurements or semiconductor failure analysis is a plus. What we cannot teach on the job is rigor with real measurement data and the habit of turning one analysis into a method the team can reuse, and that is exactly what we want you to bring.

Our benefits 

- Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

- Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

- Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

- Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

- Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

- Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

- Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

About us 

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

title: Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers) (f/m/d)
description:
Description 

QuantumDiamonds is building commercial quantum sensing tools for semiconductor inspection and failure analysis. As our Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers) , you will join the Hardware Pre-Development Team and take technical ownership of the sensing core of our widefield Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDM).

At the heart of your role is one question: how do we get more performance out of the NV sensing system? 

You will work across the complete sensing chain — from the diamond sensor and laser excitation through microwave spin control and bias magnetics to fluorescence collection and camera readout. When sensitivity, resolution, speed, or stability falls short, you will investigate the system end to end, identify the limiting mechanism, and turn your findings into measurable improvements.

The diamond sensor itself is an important part of that challenge. Together with internal experts and external partners, you will help drive the development of our NV diamond material — connecting epitaxy, irradiation, annealing, surface preparation, and optical coatings to the performance we ultimately achieve at the system level.

title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Description 

We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order.

Who we are 

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds? 

Picture this: 

- Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

- Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

- Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

- An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us? 

- You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

- From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

- Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

- You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible! 

What will you do 

- Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.

- Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.

- Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.

- Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.

- For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.

- Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.

- Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.

What is expected of you 

- Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.

- A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.

- The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.

- Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.

- Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.

- We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.

Additional experience we value: 

- Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).

- Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).

- Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).

- A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.

Our benefits 

- Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

- Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

- Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

- Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

- Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

- Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

- Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

About us 

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

title: Finance Manager (w/d/m)
description:
Finance Manager (m/w/d)

Berlin · Vor Ort · Unbefristet · So bald wie möglich

About 

LIFTED is a strength training company from Berlin. We operate several studios across the city and are opening in Munich, Hamburg, Cologne, and Düsseldorf next. We’re set to become the largest fitness company in Europe. The founding team has built and scaled a fitness company before, and we run this one owner-led, with decisions made quickly and close to the work. If that sounds like your kind of place, we’d like to meet you.

Über die Rolle 

Du wirst die erste Person bei LIFTED, die sich voll um Finance kümmert. Bisher macht das Carl, Co-Founder und Geschäftsführer, neben allem anderen. Ab jetzt baust du den Bereich mit ihm auf.

Heute haben wir sechs Studios, bis Ende 2027 werden es rund 20, in mehreren Städten. Jede Eröffnung bringt einen Business Case, ein Budget, eine Finanzierung und neue Zahlen im Monatsabschluss. Weil du direkt mit Carl arbeitest, siehst du all das aus erster Hand.

Du startest im Tagesgeschäft: Zahlungsverkehr, Monatsabschluss, Liquidität, Planung. Sobald das sauber läuft, übernimmst du mehr, bis hin zu FP&A, Business Cases für neue Studios und Finanzierung.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Steuerbüro, unserem Admin-Team, dem Expansion-Team und den City Managern zusammen.

Aufgaben

Finance Operations 
Du verantwortest den Zahlungsverkehr inklusive Gehaltslauf, Leasing und Kautionen. Die Vorkontierung macht unser Admin-Team nach klaren Regeln. Du kennst die Logik dahinter, prüfst Stichproben, klärst neue Fälle und entwickelst die Regeln in Moss weiter.

Monatsabschluss & Reporting 
Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss mit unserem Steuerbüro vor, grenzt Umsätze von Partnern wie Urban Sports Club und Trainerkosten ab und prüfst die BWA. Daraus erstellst du in Helu ein monatliches Reporting pro Studio und gleichst Plan und Ist ab.

Planung & Liquidität 
Du pflegst unsere Planung, die nach BWA-Konten und Kostenstellen aufgebaut ist, und hältst sie bei neuen Studios und Änderungen aktuell. Du planst die Liquidität rollierend und bereitest die Unterlagen für Banken und Partner vor.

HR-Administration 
Vorerst kümmerst du dich auch um Personalstammdaten, Arbeitsverträge und die Vorbereitung der Payroll.

Was du Schritt für Schritt übernimmst 
Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du FP&A: Budget, Forecast und Szenarien, etwa wenn sich bei einem neuen Studio Miete oder Eröffnungstermin ändern. Du rechnest Business Cases für neue Standorte, bevor wir unterschreiben. Du bereitest Finanzierungsgespräche vor und führst sie zunehmend mit.

Qualifikation

- Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, VWL, Finance oder einem ähnlichen Fach.

- Berufserfahrung: 2–4 Jahre in Finance, idealerweise in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.

- Antrieb: Du willst schneller lernen, als es dein bisheriger Job zulässt, und übernimmst Verantwortung, bevor dich jemand darum bittet.

- Setup: Du kennst das Zusammenspiel aus vorbereitender Buchhaltung, externem Steuerbüro und DATEV und hast schon mit SKR03 oder SKR04 gearbeitet.

- Tools: Du arbeitest sicher in Excel. Erfahrung mit Moss, Helu oder ähnlichen Tools ist ein Plus.

- Hands-on: Du packst operative Themen selbst an und baust Abläufe so, dass sie ohne dich laufen.

- Business-Interesse: Du willst verstehen, warum eine Zahl so ist, wie sie ist.

- Sprachen: Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (C2) und sicher Englisch.

- Standort: Du lebst in Berlin (oder bist bereit umzuziehen).

Benefits

- Direkt mit den Foundern: Du reportest direkt an Carl und bist seine rechte Hand bei allen Finance-Themen, mit voller Transparenz über die Zahlen. Du bekommst so viel Verantwortung, wie du übernehmen kannst, und wie weit das geht, liegt an dir.

- Steile Lernkurve: Du lernst alle Bereiche von Finance kennen, vom Zahlungsverkehr über FP&A bis zur Finanzierung.

- Coaching: Du lernst von einem Gründerteam, das schon einmal ein Fitnessunternehmen aufgebaut hat, und direkt von Carl. Wir setzen auf dich, fordern dich und helfen dir, schnell besser zu werden.

- Solides Fundament: Ein profitables Geschäft, das schnell wächst.

- Berlin HQ: Unser Büro im Prenzlauer Berg (Senefelder Platz).

- Becoming Stronger: Eine kostenlose, unbegrenzte Mitgliedschaft für alle LIFTED Studios.

- Team Spirit: Regelmäßige Teamevents wie Padel, BBQs und Trainer-Partys.

Wir schätzen deine Zeit. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen CV und eine kurze Notiz (3–5 Sätze) zu dem, worauf du in deiner bisherigen Finance-Arbeit am meisten stolz bist.

Du hast die ersten Jahre in Finance hinter dir und Lust, jetzt richtig was zu reißen? Dann bewirb dich.

title: (Senior) AI Engineer (w/d/m)
description:
Du verantwortest AI-Systeme für den Mittelstand, vom ersten Termin bei Kund:innen bis zum laufenden Betrieb. WE BUILD AI gibt es seit Februar 2025. Wir sind rund zehn Leute in einem Loftbüro in Köln-Ehrenfeld und bauen AI-Lösungen für den gehobenen Mittelstand.

- Ort: Köln-Ehrenfeld und Homeoffice

- Start: ab sofort

Bei uns gehört dir ein Projekt

Du arbeitest immer in einem Projektteam mit anderen Engineers und Consultants. Gemeinsam klärt ihr mit Fachbereich und IT-Leitung unserer Kund:innen, was sie brauchen. Die Architektur verantwortest du, und das System bauen und betreiben wir zusammen.

So läuft ein Projekt bei uns

Ein typisches Projekt hat drei Phasen, und du begleitest alle als technisch verantwortliche Person im Projektteam.

- Discovery Sprint mit dem Fachbereich: Wir legen fest, welches Problem wir lösen und woran wir den Erfolg messen.

- Pilotphase mit klaren Go/No-Go-Kriterien: Ihr baut eine erste Version, die Nutzer:innen im Fachbereich testen.

- Ausbau und Betrieb: Trägt der Pilot, bringt ihr das System in den Alltag und haltet es mit Monitoring stabil.

Deine Aufgaben

Bei aktuellen Projekten dreht es sich viel um das Training von eigenen VLMs und um das, was jedes Unternehmen umtreibt: den Einsatz von Agentic AI im gesamten Unternehmenskosmos.

- Du konzipierst LLM-Anwendungen mit RAG, strukturierter Extraktion und Agentic Workflows und entscheidest die Architektur.

- Backend-Services und APIs entwickelst du in Python, meist mit FastAPI.

- Auf Azure, meist mit Azure OpenAI und AI Foundry, bringst du die Systeme in Betrieb und betreust sie dort.

- Mit Tests, Evaluation und Monitoring sicherst du die Qualität von Anfang an.

- Gemeinsam mit unseren Consultants klärst du Anforderungen mit Fachbereich und IT-Leitung der Kund:innen.

Dein Profil

- Du hast mindestens eine LLM-Anwendung oder ein ML-Modell selbst in Betrieb gebracht, die Menschen im Arbeitsalltag nutzen.

- Python beherrschst du sicher, inklusive Tests und Deployment.

- Erfahrung mit einer Cloud-Plattform bringst du mit, am liebsten Azure, alternativ AWS oder GCP.

- Deine technischen Entscheidungen kannst du begründen, auch gegenüber Kund:innen.

- Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung in Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Feld, alternativ vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung.

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, weil der Kundenkontakt auf Deutsch läuft.

- Klassisches Machine Learning ist ein Plus.

Was wir dir bieten

- Den Aufbau eines Unternehmens begleiten und eine neue Generation von Beratung und Engineering prägen

- Benefit-Budget von 30 Euro im Monat für Gutscheine bei über 100 Anbietern, Urban Sports Club oder das Deutschlandticket

- Dienstrad-Leasing per Gehaltsumwandlung mit bis zu 40 Prozent Ersparnis, Vollkasko und Wartung inklusive

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice nach eigener Verantwortung

- Mentoring, Peer Reviews und regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche mit ehrlichem Feedback

- Gemeinsame Workations und regelmäßige Teamevents

- Loftbüro in Köln-Ehrenfeld mit Bürohunden, Getränken, Snacks und Mario Kart

Ehrlich vorab

Wir sind ein kleines Team ohne eigenes Plattform-Team, und viele technische Entscheidungen triffst du selbst. Wer lieber in einem großen Team an einem eigenen Produkt arbeitet, ist woanders vermutlich glücklicher.

Bewirb dich bei uns

Das ist der Ablauf unseres Bewerbungsverfahrens:

- Gemeinsamer Call, etwa 30 Minuten. Wir sprechen über dich und über uns.

- Probeaufgabe mit etwa 2 Stunden Aufwand. Danach stellst du deine Lösung in 45 bis 60 Minuten vor.

- Treffen in Köln mit gemeinsamem Essen, Einblick in laufende Projekte und fachlichem Sparring im Team.

Nach jedem Schritt hörst du innerhalb von einem Werktag von uns. Von der Bewerbung bis zum Angebot planen wir drei Wochen.

description:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us. 

About Expert Insights: 
Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense’s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings, delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. Through transcripts covering thousands of companies, it captures the unfiltered views and insights of business operators in the trenches, interviewed by professional investors who drill into key questions on what’s truly important about a company at each moment in time. AlphaSense’s library of over 220,000 transcripts is the market’s largest, covering all sectors of the economy, with thousands more published each month. Expert Insights is quickly becoming a table-stakes solution for institutional investors to choose the right companies to invest in while gaining rapid adoption among all other consumers of market intelligence from sell-side research and banking, consultancies, and large corporations.

About the Team: 

The Directed Content Team is an integral part of the Expert Insights group, generating thousands of calls each quarter on high-value and strategic content targets - ensuring that the AlphaSense Expert Transcript Library (ETL) delivers comprehensive coverage to our users. The Directed Content team is responsible for identifying, recruiting, and onboarding the best possible experts from around the world based on the targets and topics we are looking to generate content against - ensuring that the interviews with those experts are of the highest-possible quality and relevance.

About the Role: 

As a Sector Lead on our TMT (Technology, Media and Telecoms) Directed Content team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring AlphaSense delivers the highest-quality proprietary research content within your assigned sector. Reporting to the Director of Research (TMT) you will oversee the day-to-day execution of Directed Content projects, ensuring all work meets the firm’s standards for quality, relevance, and, end-user value delivery. As Sector Lead, you will manage coverage of EMEA and APAC companies.

You will combine operational rigor with sector expertise to oversee a team of Project Managers responsible for generating expert call transcripts across a diverse range of topics within your coverage universe. Your responsibilities will span project setup, expert sourcing guidance, transcript quality assurance, budget oversight, and performance management. Acting as the connective layer between the Director of Research’s strategic vision and day-to-day execution, you will ensure flawless delivery of sector coverage plans while maintaining a pulse on emerging market themes and client information needs.

You will also serve as a key stakeholder in developing and optimizing project workflows, implementing structured QA and feedback loops, and partnering with Product and Operations teams to pilot new AI-enabled tools that elevate both efficiency and insight quality.

What You’ll Do: 

- Partner with the Director of Research to develop and maintain a strategic sector roadmap, which you will then translate into a structured execution plan, ensuring coverage aligns with key market and client priorities.

- Manage and mentor a team of Project Managers that oversee the execution of Directed Content projects, setting clear goals, tracking KPIs, and ensuring accountability across all deliverables.

- Collaborate with Operations Managers who oversee Analyst execution of expert recruiting, onboarding, and interaction facilitation to align operational KPIs to coverage strategy and optimize execution

- Own expert budget management for your sector, allocating resources effectively to maximize content ROI while maintaining high quality and throughput.

- Oversee a structured QA process for ensuring transcripts within your sector of coverage meet the highest standards for data accuracy, relevance, structure, and analytical depth.

- Collaborate closely with the Director of Research and our Content Strategy Analyst to monitor engagement data, identify coverage gaps, and recalibrate project pipelines accordingly.

- Collaborate closely with the Director of Research to identify and shape content to support revenue-generating efforts such as white papers, webinars, internal and external presentations.

- Establish and maintain feedback loops with call takers and project teams to enhance the quality and insight of future content.

- Collaborate with North America directed content teams to ensure high quality output and consistency.

- Partner with Operations and Product teams to pilot and optimize AI-enabled tools that improve project throughput, QA precision, and overall efficiency.

- Maintain deep familiarity with ongoing developments within the Healthcare, TMT or Energy & Industrial sectors, proactively surfacing new themes and companies to guide future research focus.

Who You Are: 

- You have 5–7 years of experience in equity research, market intelligence, consulting, or a related analytical role within TMT

- You bring deep domain expertise in Technology, Media & Telecoms with a strong grasp of the key players, business models, and industry trends shaping your space.

- You have a strong understanding of European and Asian equity markets.

- You have proven people management experience, successfully leading, mentoring, and developing teams of project managers or analysts.

- You are skilled at translating strategic objectives into actionable research projects that yield high-impact insights.

- You possess exceptional organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, able to balance multiple priorities with agility while maintaining high quality standards.

- You have a strong command of project economics, capable of managing budgets, optimizing expert costs, and tracking ROI to ensure resource efficiency.

- You are adept at working cross-functionally with Directors of Research, Go-to-Market, Product, and Compliance to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.

- You are intellectually curious, client-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- You maintain a strong understanding of compliance, MNPI, and confidentiality standards across all project types.

description:
