- Experience inside a paritariste institution

- Experience inside a sector federation on its social dialogue agenda.

- Legal background in droit social and comfort reading accords collectifs quickly.

- International exposure to the European social dialogue ecosystem.

- Prior experience with RFPs or tenders involving union-negotiated or paritariste schemes.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits 

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

- Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ.

- All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

- Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). 

- Transport . Generous transit benefit

- Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

- Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Alan exists to end the wait.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
About us

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.

About the role:

Owkin is looking for a Business Development Representative to help grow opportunities across biotech, CRO, mid-size pharma and venture capital accounts. You will research target organizations, identify the right stakeholders and create qualified conversations through thoughtful, persistent outreach. Working closely with Sales Directors and cross-functional teams, you will help turn early interest into well-prepared sales opportunities while developing your consultative selling skills.

Prospecting 

- Identify target accounts (biotechs, CROs, mid-size pharma, VC), their decision-makers, their therapeutic areas, their pipelines and strategic AI organization and investment.

- Generate qualified opportunities through outbound (email, LinkedIn, phone) and at trade shows and events.

- Build relationships at several levels within key accounts, from R&D teams up to leadership.

- Qualify all the inbounds leads and route or progress them appropriately..

Supporting the sales team 

- Support Sales Directors on biotech, CRO, VC and mid-size pharma accounts.

- Prepare presentations, proposals and demos with the Technical Sales and Marketing teams.

- Coordinate internal meetings for demo (sales, product, support).

Pipeline management 

- Keep the CRM (Salesforce and third partner CSM), forecasts and reporting up to date.

- Contribute to market mapping and sales materials.

Voice of the customer 

- Synthesize customer feedback and share it with the Product team.

- Join client meetings to learn consultative selling. 

About you

Required qualifications / experience:

- A first experience in business development, SDR or B2B sales, ideally in SaaS, data and/or life sciences.

- A real drive for prospecting: you love opening doors, following up and turning a first contact into a meeting.

- Comfortable talking with scientific experts and senior decision-makers.

- Rigorous and organized: you keep your CRM up to date proactively without being asked.

- Fluent English, written and spoken. 

Preferred qualifications/bonus:

- A scientific background (biology, pharmacy, bioinformatics) or prior experience with biotechs, CROs or pharma companies.

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce and prospecting tools (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, email sequences). 

#LI-MD1

What we offer

- Flexible work organization

- Friendly and informal working environment

- Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

Recruitment Process & Security

- Please complete the form and submit your CV.

- Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

- Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

- Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

- Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @ owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

- The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn and Job Teaser, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @ Owkin.com .

- The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

- Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger 

- Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

- Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

- Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/ 

- Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities 

- Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address contact the following authorities:

- [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/ 

- [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime 

- [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

title: Legal Engineer, Tax & Audit
description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you’ll be doing

Let’s get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn’t fit neatly into a traditional box. It combines tax or audit expertise, product knowledge, client relationships and practical implementation.

As a Legal Engineer in our Paris team, you’ll help tax and audit professionals put AI to work in their day-to-day practice. You’ll work with clients from the first demonstration through pilots, onboarding and wider adoption, understanding what they need and building workflows that hold up in real engagements.

Some of what you’ll be doing:

- Understand the work. Work with tax partners, audit leaders and their teams to identify where Legora can make a meaningful difference, from tax research and advisory to evidence review and audit documentation.

- Build and test workflows. Translate client needs into working use cases, check outputs against source material and professional standards, and refine the approach with the people using it.

- Run demonstrations and training. Lead clear, practical sessions grounded in the client’s own work, adapting your approach for practitioners, partners and innovation teams.

- Own pilots and rollouts. Agree what success looks like, keep stakeholders and timelines aligned, and help teams move from initial experimentation to regular use.

- Support commercial conversations. Work alongside Go-to-Market and Customer Success colleagues to demonstrate value, address objections and identify opportunities to expand adoption across teams and service lines.

- Help improve the product. Bring client needs and product gaps back to Product and Engineering with clear examples and enough evidence to act on.

- Make good work reusable. Turn successful engagements into templates, guides and playbooks that colleagues and clients can use again.

What you bring

You come from tax, audit, assurance or a closely related advisory practice. You may have trained at a Big Four firm, worked at another professional services firm, or built your experience in an in-house function. Perhaps you’ve already moved into innovation, technology implementation or consulting.

You understand the pressure of client deadlines, the importance of defensible conclusions and how much work sits behind a finished report or piece of advice. You also have ideas about how that work could be done better.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

- Have practical experience in tax or audit and can discuss the work credibly with experienced practitioners. You don’t need to be a specialist in both.

- Are genuinely curious about generative AI and enjoy learning new tools. You don’t need to be a software engineer or have held a Legal Engineering role before.

- Communicate clearly, whether you’re explaining a technical concept, leading a workshop or handling a difficult question from a partner.

- Can organize a engagement, keep commitments, and flag problems early

- Understand the commercial realities of professional services, including engagement economics, client expectations and the balance between speed and quality.

- Take initiative, respond well to feedback and learn quickly when faced with an unfamiliar problem.

- Communicate fluently in French and English.

- Are based in Paris, or willing to relocate, and able to work from the office five days per week.

A few more things

You’ll join a growing Tax & Audit team with room to shape how we work. There is real autonomy and responsibility, alongside colleagues who will challenge your thinking and help you develop.

We’re hiring across seniority levels. Whether you’re earlier in your career or bring substantial experience, we’d like to hear from you. Your title and scope will reflect your experience and what you demonstrate during the hiring process.

If you know tax or audit and want to help build how technology is used in the profession, we’d like to meet you.

description:
Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons un budget d'environ 255 millions d'euros, avec 4794 employés dans le monde.

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. 

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens.

CONTEXTE : 

La Direction des Programmes Internationaux (DPI) de Humanité & Inclusion comprend entre autres 5 Directions Géographiques, 4 Directions Techniques, 1 Direction Atlas Logistique et 1 Direction Urgence.

La Direction Urgence est composée de 15 personnes: une équipe en charge de la veille, de l'alerte et de la préparation aux urgences et une équipe en charge des interventions d'urgence au niveau du siège et sur le terrain. C’est au sein de cette dernière, composée de 6 spécialistes des urgences et prêts à être déployés sous 72 heures que nous recrutons un ou une Responsable Réadaptation physique et Fonctionnelle en Urgence dans le cadre d’un remplacement temporaire.

OBJECTIFS DU POSTE : 

Sous la responsabilité du responsable du pool d'urgence et en étroite coordination avec les Spécialistes en Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle du siège, le responsable Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle d'urgence aura la charge de :

Participer au diagnostic initial des opérations de réponse d'urgence, à la suite d’une crise humanitaire ; 

· Contribuer à la définition de la stratégie, de la méthodologie et du dimensionnement du diagnostic initial, y compris la création et/ou l'adaptation des outils d'évaluation des besoins ;

· Participer aux évaluations des besoins ;

· Contribuer à l'analyse des résultats et à la définition de la stratégie de réponse immédiate en anticipant le nexus urgence-réhabilitation-développement ;

· Contribuer à l'élaboration du projet et à la rédaction des propositions ;

Diriger et coordonner : 

Piloter le déploiement des activités de réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle lors de l’ouverture de nouveaux programmes d’urgence, en assurant la définition du cadre opérationnel, le management des équipes, la coordination avec les autres secteurs d’intervention et les partenaires, ainsi que le suivi de la qualité, du budget, des résultats et du reporting. Le poste contribue également à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie d’intervention d’urgence, au renforcement des capacités des équipes et partenaires, et à la capitalisation des retours d’expérience.

Représenter et promouvoir le mandat d’Humanité & Inclusion dans le cadre des réponses d’urgence dans votre domaine d’expertise ; 

· Promouvoir le mandat et son positionnement en coordination avec les partenaires de mise en œuvre ;

· Représenter et participer aux mécanismes de coordination des réponses liées à la Réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle d’urgence (groupe de travail santé, groupe de travail traumatologie etc…)

· Participer, sur demande de la hiérarchie, aux actions liées aux campagnes de plaidoyer et institutionnelles mises en œuvre par Humanité & Inclusion au siège et/ou sur le terrain ;

· Contribuer à la mobilisation des acteurs publics et privés pour assurer l’inclusion de la vulnérabilité et du handicap dans leurs programmes et initiatives.

Contribuer à la capitalisation institutionnelle et participer au développement et à la mise à jour des méthodologies, procédures, outils et formations d'urgence d’Humanité & Inclusion. 

· Participer aux travaux de formalisation et de capitalisation dans son domaine d'expertise en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de secteur et le spécialiste technique du siège ;

· Participer à la stratégie Direction Urgence et autres, si nécessaire ;

· Contribuer de façon proactive et constructive à la conception des processus et méthodologies de réponse aux urgences ;

· Contribuer au développement et/ou à l'optimisation des outils, procédures et ressources utilisés par Humanité & Inclusion pour la réponse aux urgences en étroite collaboration avec le spécialiste technique du siège.

· Contribuer au renforcement des capacités de réponse aux urgences du personnel et/ou des partenaires d'Humanité & Inclusion en fonction des besoins identifiés ;

· Contribuer à l'amélioration des outils et modules de formation dans ses domaines d'expertise ;

· Participer activement aux ateliers organisés au sein de l'Equipe de Réponse aux Urgences ou par d'autres départements au sein d'Humanité & Inclusion, en relation avec les réponses aux urgences

· Apporter un support au spécialiste technique du siège sur des sujets spécifiques et transversaux.

Requirements 

Vous avez une expérience d’au moins trois ans en réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle en contexte d’urgence et votre situation personnelle actuelle vous permet d’être déployé sous 72 heures ? Voici plus en détail le profil requis pour ce poste passionnant ouvert dans le cadre d’un remplacement temporaire :

Formation / Connaissances 

- Un diplôme de kinésithérapeute ou ergothérapeute

- Une formation complémentaire en gestion et développement de projets / opérations humanitaires ou équivalent de préférence dans le domaine de l’action humanitaire internationale

- Bonne connaissance des réglementations et processus des bailleurs d’urgence

- Langues : anglais et français maitrisés. La maitrise de l’espagnol ou l’arabe serait un plus.

- Informatique : maitrise du Pack Office

Profil recherché 

- Expérience confirmée d’au moins 2 ans dans des fonctions de coordination ou de management de projets en réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle.
- Solide expérience clinique récente en réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle, notamment dans les domaines de l’orthopédie, de la traumatologie, de la rééducation respiratoire et/ou des brûlés.

Niché au cœur de Genève, notre palace emblématique incarne l’élégance, le raffinement et l’excellence du service hôtelier de luxe. Engagé dans un ambitieux projet de rénovation visant à sublimer son héritage tout en redéfinissant les standards contemporains du luxe, l’établissement ouvre un nouveau chapitre de son histoire.

Pour accompagner cette transformation et soutenir nos équipes au quotidien, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines H/F .

Votre mission :

Rattaché(e) à la Directrice des Ressources Humaines, vous assurez la gestion RH quotidienne et accompagnez les collaborateurs tout au long de leur parcours au sein de la Maison.

Véritable interlocuteur(trice) de proximité, vous intervenez sur l’ensemble des sujets liés à l’administration du personnel, à la paie, au recrutement et à l’expérience collaborateur.

Polyvalent(e), autonome et organisé(e), vous évoluez au sein d’une équipe RH à taille humaine et contribuez activement à garantir une gestion fiable et rigoureuse, tout en maintenant une relation de proximité avec les collaborateurs et les équipes opérationnelles.

Vos responsabilités principales :

- Administration du personnel : Assurer la gestion administrative des collaborateurs, de leur entrée à leur sortie : contrats, avenants, attestations, certificats de travail, permis de travail et autres documents RH.
- Suivi des collaborateurs : Garantir la bonne tenue des dossiers collaborateurs, la fiabilité des données administratives et leur mise à jour régulière.
- Gestion des absences : Assurer le suivi des absences, vacances, congés et certificats médicaux.
- Accompagnement RH : Être un point de contact privilégié pour les collaborateurs et répondre à leurs questions relatives aux différents sujets RH.
- Onboarding & Offboarding : Coordonner les différentes étapes d’intégration et de départ des collaborateurs, en collaboration avec la Direction des Ressources Humaines et les départements concernés.
- Paie & Gestion des temps : Assurer le processus mensuel des salaires, le suivi des temps de travail et des éléments variables de paie jusqu’à la clôture.
- Recrutement : Participer à l’ensemble du processus de recrutement selon les besoins : publication des annonces, suivi des candidatures, entretiens et accompagnement jusqu’à l’engagement définitif.
- Relations Écoles : Contribuer au développement et au suivi des partenariats avec les écoles hôtelières afin de renforcer notre attractivité auprès des futurs talents.
- Communication & Événements internes : Participer à la communication RH ainsi qu’à l’organisation des événements destinés aux collaborateurs.
- Projets RH & Expérience Collaborateur : Contribuer aux différents projets RH et proposer des initiatives visant à améliorer continuellement l’expérience collaborateur.

Profil :

- Formation : Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école hôtelière (Bachelor ou équivalent) et avez complété votre parcours par une formation en Ressources Humaines .
- Expérience : Vous disposez d’une expérience d’au minimum 3 ans dans une fonction RH similaire , obligatoirement acquise dans le secteur de l’hôtellerie-restauration .
- Paie : Vous maîtrisez les processus de paie, le suivi des temps de travail et la gestion des éléments variables de salaire.
- Connaissances RH : Vous disposez idéalement de bonnes connaissances du droit du travail suisse et des assurances sociales .
- Outils : Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes d’information RH.
- Organisation : Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et assurer un suivi précis de vos dossiers.
- Relationnel : Vous appréciez le contact humain et savez instaurer une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs, tout en respectant la stricte confidentialité inhérente à la fonction RH.
- Posture : Autonome, dynamique et polyvalent(e), vous appréciez de travailler au sein d’une petite équipe où l’entraide, la réactivité et l’autonomie sont essentielles.
- Langues : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit . La maîtrise de l’anglais constitue un réel atout.
- Personnalité : Vous êtes force de proposition, orienté(e) solutions et aimez contribuer à une ambiance de travail positive.

Pourquoi rejoindre la Maison Beau-Rivage ?

- Une fonction RH polyvalente et proche du terrain , au cœur de la vie de la Maison.
- L’opportunité d’accompagner les collaborateurs à chaque étape de leur parcours.
- Une participation active à la transformation d’un établissement emblématique en pleine rénovation.
- Des missions variées associant administration RH, paie, recrutement, relations écoles et expérience collaborateur .
- Un environnement de travail stimulant et exigeant au cœur de Genève.
- La possibilité de contribuer concrètement aux projets RH qui accompagneront le nouveau chapitre de Beau-Rivage.

Rejoignez Beau-Rivage et contribuez à faire vivre une expérience collaborateur à la hauteur de l’excellence de notre Maison.

title: Content & Social Growth Manager:in (80–100 %)
description:
Was bluu bewegt

Wir bei bluu verändern, wie Menschen ihren Haushalt machen.
Unsere Produkte, zum Beispiel unsere Waschstreifen, machen Waschen und Putzen leichter. Ohne schwere Flaschen, ohne Schnickschnack.

Ein gutes Produkt allein reicht aber nicht. Warum bleibt jemand beim Scrollen bei uns hängen? Welcher Trend passt zu bluu und welcher nicht? Warum funktioniert ein Creative diese Woche und nächste Woche nicht mehr? Und wie wird aus einem Like eine Bestellung, in der Schweiz und bald auch in Europa?

Genau dafür suchen wir dich. 
Wir holen Content und Creative gerade ins Haus. Meta läuft seit August bei uns statt bei einer Agentur. Jetzt suchen wir eine Person, die Verantwortung übernimmt: für unseren Content, für unsere organischen Kanäle und dafür, dass bluu in der Schweiz und in Europa sichtbar wird und wächst.

Deine Verantwortung

- Organic Social Growth: Du verantwortest das organische Wachstum unserer Kanäle @bluuwash in der Schweiz. Gleichzeitig baust du sie im EU-Raum aus. Dein Ziel: mehr Markenbekanntheit und mehr Umsatz in jedem Markt.

- Sparring Paid Social: Unsere Junior Growth & Brand Managerin betreut die Paid-Kanäle. Du bist ihr Sparringpartner: Ihr schaut gemeinsam auf die Performance, leitet daraus ab, was als Nächstes kommt, und du setzt es direkt als Content um.

- Content & Creatives: Du entscheidest, wie bluu dargestellt wird und wie unsere Ads aussehen. Du entwickelst Angles und Hooks und schreibst die Ad-Skripte, für unsere eigenen Videos und für unsere UGC-Creator. Du filmst und schneidest selbst. Hinter der Kamera bist du sicher unterwegs. Wenn du auch gern vor der Kamera stehst, umso besser.

- Organic Content aus dem Alltag: Du filmst Office-, Behind-the-Scenes- und Produktcontent und machst daraus Reichweite auf unseren Kanälen.

- E-Mail, WhatsApp & Redaktionsplan: Du verantwortest das gesamte E-Mail-Marketing und baust WhatsApp als neuen Kanal auf. Die Leitplanken für den Redaktionsplan setzen wir gemeinsam mit der Head of Marketing. Die Detailplanung und die Umsetzung über alle Kanäle liegen bei dir.

Das sind deine Kernaufgaben, nicht die ganze Stelle. 
Wir sind ein Startup, und die Rolle entwickelt sich mit uns. Laufend kommen neue Themen dazu, zum Beispiel:

- neue Produkte im Markt positionieren und dafür den passenden Content entwickeln

- Content laufend anpassen, testen und weiterentwickeln, je nachdem, was funktioniert

- neue Formate, Kanäle und Märkte ausprobieren

Wenn du gern Neues anpackst und dich wechselnde Prioritäten nicht aus dem Konzept bringen, bist du bei uns richtig.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Junior Growth & Brand Managerin, mit Customer Experience und mit Product zusammen und berichtest direkt an die Head of Marketing.

Das bringst du mit

- mehrjährige Erfahrung im Social Media, Content oder Digital Marketing, idealerweise bei einer D2C-Marke mit Onlineshop

- nachweisbare Erfolge beim Aufbau organischer Social-Kanäle

- Du liest Performance-Daten, zum Beispiel aus Meta Ads, und leitest daraus ab, welcher Content als Nächstes kommt

- Du filmst und schneidest selbst, zum Beispiel mit CapCut, Premiere oder vergleichbaren Tools

- Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing, idealerweise mit Klaviyo

Nice to have: 

- Erfahrung mit dem Ausbau in neue Märkte, zum Beispiel DE oder AT

- erste Erfahrung mit WhatsApp-Marketing

- Erfahrung mit Creator- und UGC-Kooperationen

- Du stehst ab und zu gern selbst vor der Kamera

Das erwartet dich bei bluu

- echte Verantwortung für Kanäle und Märkte, die du selbst prägst

- ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und echten Entscheiden

- Themen, die du von null aufbaust, zum Beispiel WhatsApp und neue EU-Märkte

- ein Büro mitten in Zürich, Homeoffice bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche

- bis zu zwei Wochen pro Jahr arbeitest du, von wo du möchtest

- enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem ganzen Team, auch bei neuen Produktideen

- viel Raum für eigene Ideen: Wenn etwas Sinn macht, probieren wir es aus

So bewirbst du dich

Variante A: Motivationsvideo (max. 3 Minuten) 
Erzähl uns:

- was dich an bluu und der Stelle begeistert

- Warum genau du perfekt für die Stelle passt

- wo du aktuell den grössten Hebel für bluu siehst

- eine konkrete Content-Idee für @bluuwash

Format, Stil und Setting wählst du selbst. Sei kreativ und bring deine Persönlichkeit rein. Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, nicht wie perfekt du dich präsentierst.

Variante B: Motivationsschreiben und Portfolio 
Im Motivationsschreiben erzählst du uns, warum du zu bluu passt. Im Portfolio zeigst du Content, den du selbst konzipiert, gefilmt oder geschnitten hast, am besten mit ein paar Worten dazu, was funktioniert hat und warum.

Wichtig: Verlinke dein Video oder dein Portfolio direkt in deinem CV, zum Beispiel über YouTube, Vimeo, Google Drive oder deine eigene Website.

Wir suchen keine Person, die Content nur plant.
Wir suchen jemanden, der einen Trend morgens sieht, ihn am Nachmittag umsetzt und am nächsten Tag weiss, ob er funktioniert hat.

title: ML Intern: Optimization Quality & Monitoring
description:
Our common vision

Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful.

About the role

Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions.

Your responsibilities

Monitor the automation and assure result quality

- Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness.

- Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects.

- Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis.

Assure the quality of results over time

- Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests.

- Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks.

- Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team.

Safeguard data and model quality

- Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality.

- Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early.

- Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams.

Automate the operational workflow

- Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts.

- Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios.

- Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person.

The impact you will have

- Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time.

- Issues are caught before customers see them, not after.

- The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated.

- Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand.

Your experience and skills

- Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.

- Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL.

- Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting.

- A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do.

- Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues.

- Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must.

Bonus points

- Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization.

- Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics.

- Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools.

- Experience with Git, Docker and cloud environments.

- Fluent in German or Italian.

Your future work life

- Purpose: Your work directly influences how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets.

- Responsibility: You own the quality of a defined part of our automation from day one, with a personal development roadmap and regular feedback.

- Learning: You work alongside experienced ML and data engineers on production systems, not on side projects.

- Culture: A transparent company culture at eye level, where every person is valued and supported.

- Strategy: You take part in shaping company strategy and culture during our quarterly Strategy Days.

- Events: Regular team events, on-site and off-site.

Application process

- Profile review and short phone screen

- Take-home case study

- Case discussion with the ML team

- On-site interview and team evaluation

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Summary

Nebius Token Factory is building production-grade inference for open-source, customer, and internally optimized models. This role owns the path from model artifact to fast, reliable, cost-efficient endpoint. The work sits at the intersection of model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, benchmarking, and production deployment.

What You Will Do

- 
Own a platform-level optimization pillar such as quantization, speculative decoding, KV -cache optimization, engine selection, or long-context serving.

- 
Create reusable evaluation, benchmarking, and rollout frameworks across multiple model families.

- 
Provide technical direction to MLEs, Applied Scientists, GPU kernel engineers, and infrastructure engineers on shared performance goals.

- 
Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

- 
Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar systems.

- 
Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

- 
Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV -cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

- 
Build reproducible benchmark harnesses for TTFT , TPOT , tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.

- 
Partner with GPU kernel engineers and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

- 
Write clear design docs, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Required Qualifications

- 
Strong Python and PyTorch engineering skills.

- 
Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM , or high-throughput transformer inference systems.

- 
Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or equivalent internal systems.

- 
Strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks, including KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.

- 
Ability to reason quantitatively about latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost tradeoffs.

- 
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- 
Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8 , INT8 , INT4 , NVFP4 , MXFP4 , AWQ , GPTQ , SmoothQuant, or related techniques.

- 
Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or other inference acceleration methods.

- 
Experience with agentic workloads, including tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.

- 
CUDA or Triton familiarity, even if the role is not primarily a kernel-engineering role.

- 
Open-source contributions to vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, KServe, or related projects.

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Performance Marketing Manager - Paid Social (m/f/d)
description:
About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social , you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market. 

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities 

- Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
- Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
- Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
- Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
- Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
- Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
- Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
- Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.
Requirements 

Background & Experience 

- At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets.
- Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform.
- A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making.
- Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
- Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
- Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.
- Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics.
- Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.
Benefits 

What Makes You A Great Fit 

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us? 

- Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
- Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
- Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
- Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.
- Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location).
Ready to Move the Needle? 

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Energetic Materials Scientist (Munitions)
description:
About Us 

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role 

As Energetic Materials Engineer in the Warhead team, you will be the technical authority ensuring the energetic materials in our systems are properly selected, tested and qualified for their intended use. You will build Harmattan AI’s expertise in energetic materials chemistry, stability and supplier assurance, so we can safely and repeatedly source and produce energetics as we scale. You will work daily with systems, warhead and fuze engineers, as well as test facilities and partners.

Responsibilities 

- Act as the internal reference on energetic materials chemistry, properties and compatibility to guide material selection.

- Baseline the energetic materials requirements and material inventory across our products.

- Evaluate chemical stability, ageing and environmental sensitivity to define safe-for-use, storage and operational requirements.

- Develop and oversee material qualification in line with NATO standards, internally and with external partners.

- Run hands-on material characterization and build the laboratory capability, in-house or through partners, to support it.

- Assess supplier specifications, process capability and quality requirements to ensure repeatability and traceability, and manage inspections and non-conformances.

- Support warhead and fuze engineers in sourcing and preparing materials for prototype testing, and report results to systems engineers.

- Build qualification frameworks and guidance for the wider team, and contribute to growing an internal materials team.

Candidate Requirements 

- Master’s degree or PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering or a related field.

- Strong understanding of explosive materials, propellants and pyrotechnics, including explosive safety and hazardous materials handling.

- Hands-on experience with analytical techniques such as DSC, TGA, FTIR and Raman spectroscopy.

- Experience characterizing and evaluating materials in accordance with NATO qualification standards.

- Experience running qualification programs for materials used in pyrotechnic or energetic systems.

- Understanding of materials manufacturing processes and quality controls.

- Fluency in English required.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

- Fundierte Erfahrung in IT-Strategie, Digitalisierung, IT-Architektur und Transformation inklusive Change Management

- Strategische und unternehmerische Denkweise, pragmatische Umsetzungsstärke, hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit

- Fähigkeit, Interessengruppen zu verbinden und Mitarbeitende für Veränderungen zu gewinnen

Arbeitsort: Bern. Pensum 100 %.

title: Industrial Software Engineer - Railway Applications (m/w/d) 80-100%
description:
About Traila 

At Traila, we are dedicated to shaping the future of rail transport through cutting-edge technology. Since our founding in 2017, we have been driven by a passion for sustainability and excellence. We believe that rail transport is a cornerstone of a greener future, and our mission is to make it quieter, more efficient, and more reliable.

Our talented team is at the heart of this mission, and we are looking for an Industrial Software Engineer - Railway Applications to join us in developing robust software solutions that operate reliably in real-world railway environments.

What you will do 

- Industrial Software Development: Design, implement and maintain robust application software for industrial and railway products using C++, C#, Python or comparable technologies.

- Application & System Integration: Translate system and operational requirements into practical software functionality and integrate software with real hardware and physical systems.

- Hardware & Device Interfaces: Integrate sensors, actuators, controllers, DAQ systems and other industrial devices.

- Communication Protocols: Implement and troubleshoot interfaces such as CAN/CANopen, EtherCAT, TCP/IP and other industrial or vehicle communication protocols.

- Controls & Application Logic: Implement state machines, operational logic, control functionality and system behaviour required by the application.

- Commissioning & Field Support: Support installation, commissioning and field testing on prototypes, test systems and rail vehicles, including travel to customer and test sites when required.

- Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Analyse logs, interfaces and system behaviour to identify root causes and solve software and integration issues efficiently.

- Testing & Validation: Develop unit, integration and system-level tests and contribute to HIL/SIL or other validation activities where relevant.

- Software Architecture, Quality & Controlled Releases: Own software architecture and release discipline, including configuration and version control, code reviews, test evidence and controlled software releases.

- Product Cybersecurity: Own threat assessment, secure access and software updates, vulnerability handling and lifecycle security maintenance; coordinate specialist security reviews and work with Systems/RAMS on vehicle interfaces and safety consequences.

- Technical Guidance & Mentoring: Review implementations, share practical software-engineering practices and mentor colleagues to strengthen consistency, maintainability and technical ownership across the team.

- Tools & Data: Develop tools for configuration, testing, diagnostics, data acquisition and analysis that support engineering and field activities.

- Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Maintain clear software and interface documentation and improve existing code as Traila products mature from development into deployed systems.

What you bring 

- Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical technical experience.

- Hands-on professional software-development experience in an industrial, automation, automotive, machinery or comparable technical environment.

- Proven professional railway software experience, including products released and maintained in service.

- Strong practical programming skills in C++, C#, Python or a comparable industrial software stack; you do not need to be an expert in every language listed.

- Experience developing software that interacts with real hardware, devices or physical systems.

- Experience taking software beyond prototypes into tested, maintainable and deployable industrial use.

- Practical railway software lifecycle experience aligned with EN 50716:2023, including requirements traceability, configuration management and verification/validation appropriate to the required software integrity level; relevant EN 50128 / EN 50657 predecessor experience is also valuable.

- Practical embedded or industrial cybersecurity experience, including secure credentials and access, signed software updates and rollback, and handling vulnerabilities in released products.

- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across software, communication and hardware interfaces.

- Experience with Git and structured software-development workflows.

- A practical ownership mindset: comfortable working directly with prototypes, test equipment and deployed systems and driving technical problems through to resolution.

- Ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines and communicate technical issues clearly.

- Fluent English; German is a strong advantage.

Nice to have 

- Experience with industrial Linux, embedded Linux, automation or control systems.

- MATLAB/Simulink, HIL/SIL testing, data acquisition or condition-monitoring experience.

- Working knowledge of railway cybersecurity under CLC/TS 50701:2023 and of EN IEC 62443-4-1 (secure development) and EN IEC 62443-4-2 (component security) is desirable.

- Familiarity with EN 50155 and EN 50126 for equipment integration and collaboration with Systems/RAMS.

- Experience in a regulated or safety-relevant product-development environment.

Benefits 

- 25 days of annual leave, plus paid bridge days at Christmas.

- Flexible working hours and home office options.

- Annual professional development allowance for courses, certifications and conferences.

- Competitive compensation with milestone bonus scheme and full Swiss social coverage.

- A collaborative team culture with regular social and sports activities.

- Real autonomy and short decision-making paths.

If you want your software engineering to have real-world impact in rail, we’d like to hear from you. 

Contact Yasi Samari, HR Responsible, by applying directly here.

title: Account Executive (German Speaking)
description:
Company Overview 

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm 

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: this role is based out of the EMEA territory, specifically Switzerland/Zurich/Geneva. 

Regional Expectations 

- Based in an EMEA time zone with strong overlap to customer business hours.

- Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a strong plus.

German Language Expectations 

- Native-level or full professional fluency in German (written and spoken), with the ability to conduct complex sales conversations and negotiations.

Opportunity 

Deepgram is looking for an Account Executive to drive new customers and revenue to our rapidly growing company, specifically in the German markets. You will have the opportunity to sell a patented world-class voice AI platform that has been enabling our customers to achieve things previously not attainable. We are looking for hungry and talented sales professionals to help us take our top-line revenue to new heights!

What You'll Do 

- Self-prospecting to build a strong sales pipeline of new logos, striving to exceed quarterly and annual sales targets, as well as partnering with the Marketing and SDR teams to generate meetings

- Work closely with cross-functional teams (especially Sales Ops and Sales Engineers) to ensure sales effectiveness

- Have a depth of understanding regarding customer needs in the voice AI space, competition, and Deepgram products to be able to articulate Deepgram’s value proposition fully to highly technical buyers

- Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, work with CSMs to drive upsell opportunities and manage existing accounts ongoing

You’ll Love This Role If You 

- Value having leadership that has tenure and a track record of success

- Thrive working with A Players as cross-functional partners across GTM

- Understand the importance of selling a product that is market validated and can deliver on its technical promise

- Believe there should be no cap to upside and want control of account up-sell potential

- Are passionate about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech

It’s Important to Us That You Have 

- Proven experience in a technical full-cycle sales role

- Experience building your own pipeline from scratch and closing accounts

- Consistent overachievement against sales targets in past experiences

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Empathy and a unique ability to understand customer needs

- Highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills due to managing multiple opportunities at any given time

- Ability to drive a consistent and repeatable sales process with a coachable/adaptable mindset based on other rep success.

- It Would Be Great If You Had 

- Familiarity with Challenger or Triangle sales methodology

- Experience selling to a technical audience in a similar space

- Experience selling developer tools, infrastructure, or AI/ML technologies.

- Fluency in German, French, Dutch, or other major regional languages.

title: Senior Director, Patient Advocacy & Communications Lead, EMEA
description:
Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. 

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn. 

Summary of Position: 

The Patient Advocacy & Corporate Communications Lead, EMEA will be responsible for developing and executing integrated patient advocacy and communications strategies that advance the company's mission, strengthen stakeholder trust, and support business objectives across the region, starting with Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA) and including facioscapulohumeral dystrophy (FSHD) in line with clinical development milestones. 

This role will serve as the primary EMEA lead for patient advocacy engagement while also driving corporate and product communications, executive visibility, disease awareness initiatives, and internal communications. The successful candidate will engage the SMA community (and communities for future disease states) to establish and solidify trust and act as a connector to patient and advocate perspectives to drive Scholar Rock’s patient first values. They will act as a trusted strategic advisor to regional leadership and work cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Global patient advocacy and communications, Market Access, Clinical Development, Regulatory, and Commercial Teams, supported by global and regional agency partners.

The ideal candidate combines deep understanding of the rare disease community with exceptional communications and stakeholder management capabilities and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial biotech environment.

Position Responsibilities 

Patient Advocacy Leadership 
Develop and Execute Advocacy Strategy

- Contribute to the development and implementation of a comprehensive EMEA patient advocacy strategy aligned with corporate and regional objectives, starting in the SMA community and building the FSHD relationships.

- Ensure patient and caregiver perspectives are appropriately incorporated throughout the product lifecycle, from clinical development through commercialization.

- Identify emerging opportunities and risks within the advocacy and policy environment and provide strategic recommendations to leadership.

- Foster a patient-centric culture throughout the organization.

Build Meaningful Community Partnerships

- Establish and maintain authentic, trusted relationships with regional and national patient organizations, advocacy leaders, caregivers, and community stakeholders.

- Serve as the primary company representative to patient advocacy organizations associated with direct-to-market counties throughout EMEA

- Support development of and monitor execution against a patient advocacy group engagement playbook for partner market countries ensuring advocate engagement follows Scholar Rock standards

- Identify, deliver, and participate in collaborative initiatives that support disease awareness, education, research, access, and policy priorities.

- Build long-term collaboration based on transparency, trust, and shared goals.

Generate Patient Insights

- Execute patient advisory boards, caregiver councils, listening sessions, and community engagement initiatives.

- Collect and translate patient insights into actionable recommendations for internal teams.

- Partner with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, and Market Access to ensure the patient voice informs strategic decision-making.

- Drive initiatives that better understand the patient and caregiver journey across EMEA markets.

Corporate Communications Leadership 
Corporate Reputation & Narrative

- Develop and execute a comprehensive EMEA communications strategy that enhances company reputation and stakeholder trust.

- Shape and implement compelling corporate narratives that articulate the company's mission, vision, scientific innovation, and commitment to patients.

- Ensure consistency of messaging and brand positioning across all EMEA communications activities.

- Support the development of disease area leadership and corporate positioning strategies.

Media & External Communications

- Manage regional media relations and proactive communications opportunities.

- Draft and oversee press releases, corporate announcements, leadership messaging, Q&A documents, and stakeholder communications aligned with relevant global advocacy and communications plans

You help evolve a mature monolithic codebase into a more modular, testable and future-proof architecture. By modernising the foundation of the product, you directly enable better user experiences, faster iteration and higher overall product quality.

Core technical expertise

title: Projectontwikkelaar
description:
Ben jij een projectontwikkelaar met een passie voor vastgoed en gebiedsontwikkeling? Heb je al de nodige vlieguren gemaakt met complexe projecten en voel je je thuis in samenwerkingen met diverse partijen? Wil je zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken aan uitdagende projecten, van haalbaarheid tot realisatie? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Dit wordt jouw baan 

Als projectontwikkelaar leid je vastgoedprojecten van concept tot realisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling, verkoop en het volledige procesmanagement. Van haalbaarheidsstudies tot de start van de bouw: jij houdt het overzicht. Je onderhoudt relaties met partners, beleggers, woningcorporaties en overheden en zorgt voor een vlotte samenwerking tussen alle betrokkenen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamspeler die bij gebiedsontwikkelingen bijdraagt aan het realiseren van impact op jouw (deel)project.

Dankzij je ervaring met complexe projecten (appartementen en binnenstedelijke ontwikkelingen) weet je snel te schakelen tussen belanghebbenden en bewaak je het totaalplaatje, inclusief conceptontwikkeling, duurzaamheid, budget en planning.

Wat ga je doen? 

- Markt & Klant: Analyseren van de marktvraag en het ontwikkelen van passende product-marktcombinaties. Opstellen van grond- en vastgoedexploitaties en coördineren van verkooptrajecten. Onderhouden en uitbouwen van relaties met beleggers en woningcorporaties.

- Locatie & RO: Begeleiden van RO-procedures en vergunningstrajecten.

- Organisatie: Coördineren van het ontwikkelings- en ontwerpproces, inclusief de financiële en commerciële aspecten.

- Tijd & Geld: Opstellen en bewaken van exploitaties en planningen, uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en voeren van onderhandelingen om de beste resultaten te behalen. Jij hebt als geen ander gevoel voor het sluiten van goede deals.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer 

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. 

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. 

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. 

Focus op vastgoed bij Dura Vermeer 

Dura Vermeer heeft grote ambities als ontwikkelaar. In onze portefeuille vind je uitdagende (gebieds)ontwikkelingen met onderscheidende concepten, veelal op binnenstedelijke locaties. Ons werkgebied beslaat Zuid-Holland, waar we de stedelijke uitdagingen omarmen en maximale waarde willen toevoegen in onze plannen. Dit resulteert in projecten waar je echt impact kunt maken op gebieden als stedenbouw, architectuur, duurzaamheid en sociale cohesie. 

Als organisatie groeien we naar een vestiging waar jaarlijks 800 woningen risicodragend worden geacquireerd en verkocht. Dit betekent dat we zelf het risico dragen van de aankoop tot verkoop van de woningen. Jij speelt een belangrijke rol in onze complexe ontwikkelingen. 

Dura Vermeer onderscheidt zich op het gebied van samenwerking. We werken nauw samen met gemeentes, partners en stakeholders binnen onze projecten, en zeker ook met onze collega’s in Rotterdam. We staan bekend om onze intensieve en oprechte samenwerking, die leidt tot innovatieve en duurzame oplossingen in elk project. 

Op nationaal niveau heeft Dura Vermeer een sterke vastgoedorganisatie waar je op kunt terugvallen. Regelmatig ontmoet je collega’s van andere vestigingen om kennis uit te wisselen en expertise te ontwikkelen. Met onze interne gebiedsstudio, ID, bieden we een expertisecentrum voor ruimtelijke ontwikkeling, marktadvies en verkoopmanagement, acquisitie en gebiedsontwikkeling, dat je ondersteunt bij jouw projectopgaven. 

Met recent gewonnen tenders zoals Sportcampus Rotterdam , WijCK Pijnacker en De Werf in Oegstgeest en de aankoop van het Hunter Douglas terrein in Rotterdam laten we zien dat we meedraaien op het hoogste niveau van gebiedsontwikkeling. 

Hier zit je op je plek 

Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het ontwikkelen van gebieden en buurten en het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen. 

Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige teams, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams. 

Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken! 

Dit breng je mee

title: Stagiair(e) Energie en Leefomgeving
description:
31-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,– stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master | 6-12 maanden 

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot 

De energietransitie is in volle gang. Overheden en bedrijven werken toe naar het behalen van Europese en landelijke doelstellingen, maar dit is vaak makkelijker gezegd dan gedaan. Om beleid tot uitvoering te brengen, moeten uiteenlopende belangen, overtuigingen en visies bijeenkomen. De grenzen tussen beleid en uitvoering zijn daarbij soms vaag. Op dat snijvlak werken wij: wat is de beste strategie om de doelen te behalen, en hoe werken we daar samen naartoe? Daar heb je kennis van de energietransitie voor nodig, maar ook gevoel voor mensen, context en organisaties. Dit is uitdagend, complex en leuk! 

Wil jij meewerken aan de meest urgente energie- en klimaatvraagstukken van Nederland? Wil jij met frisse ideeën en nieuwe inzichten bijdragen aan oplossingen voor uiteenlopende organisaties? En ben je benieuwd naar het werk bij een adviesbureau? Berenschot biedt jou de kans om tijdens een stage actief mee te werken aan deze complexe en actuele uitdagingen! De startdatum van je stage is 1 oktober 2026 (in overleg). 

Dit ga je doen 

Als stagiair(e) werk je onder andere mee aan opdrachten die gaan over energiesystemen, netcongestie, de warmtetransitie, betaalbaarheid en systeemweerbaarheid, op landelijk, regionaal én lokaal niveau. Opdrachtgevers zijn overheden (ministeries, provincies, gemeenten), netbeheerders, energiebedrijven, uitvoeringsorganisaties en woningbouwcorporaties. Daarbij werken we niet alleen voor, maar vooral ook mét onze opdrachtgevers. 

Een aantal voorbeelden van opdrachten waaraan wij werk(t)en: 

- Het uitdenken en opbouwen van grote nationale uitvoeringsprogramma’s van het Klimaatakkoord, zoals het Nationaal Programma RES, het Nationaal Programma Lokale Warmtetransitie, het Nationaal Plan Energiesysteem, en programma’s rondom hernieuwbare opwek (zon op dak, wind op land, etc.). 

- Het begeleiden van (grote) gemeenten bij het ontwikkelen van een warmte(net)strategie. 

- Het ondersteunen van netbeheerders en provincies bij de ontwikkeling en programmering van het energiesysteem van de toekomst (Energievisies) en het verminderen van netcongestie. 

- Overheden helpen met het opstellen van effectief klimaatbeleid met behulp van prognoses op basis van onze eigen Regionale CO2-routekaart. 

- Het uitvoeren van volumeprojecties voor waterstofdragers richting 2035, om inzicht te krijgen in de verschillende stromen en knelpunten. 

- Het ontwikkelen van een alternatief nettariefstelsel voor netbeheerders, waarmee de netbelasting wordt gespreid en netcongestie wordt beperkt. 

- Overheden helpen met het opstellen en uitvoeren van beleid en plannen om de energietransitie rechtvaardiger te maken (bijvoorbeeld door bestrijding van energiearmoede, de inzet van fix-teams, het sturen op isolatie, etc.) 

Tijdens jouw stage krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan adviesopdrachten en lever je een bijdrage aan interne projecten, zoals bijvoorbeeld evenementen. Welke adviesopdrachten je doet, bepalen we samen met jou (afhankelijk van jouw interesses, achtergrond en kennis, en welke opdrachten er lopen). 

Quote 

“De variatie aan projecten, klanten en collega’s zorgt ervoor dat je snel een beeld krijgt van wat je doet als consultant. Je werkt als stagiair(e) écht mee aan maatschappelijk relevante projecten!” 

Hier kom je terecht 

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. 

Dit zijn je directe collega’s 

Je gaat aan de slag binnen de adviesgroep Energie en leefomgeving in het Expertisecentrum Energie & Strategie (ECES). We zijn een club jonge, enthousiaste en ambitieuze professionals die sterk gemotiveerd zijn om bij te dragen aan de energietransitie. Je collega’s hebben bijvoorbeeld (technische) bestuurskunde gestudeerd, of bedrijfskunde, planologie, energy and environmental sciences, milieustudies, of politicologie. 

Dit neem je mee 

Berenschot is een verzameling van persoonlijkheden en achtergronden. We kijken dus vooral of je goed in het team past. We zoeken in elk geval een flinke dosis energie en enthousiasme, gecombineerd met nieuwsgierigheid en de ambitie om jezelf op inhoud en adviesvaardigheden te ontwikkelen. Je werkt graag zelfstandig, maar net zo goed samen. Verder heb je: 

- een sterk analytisch vermogen en uitstekende sociale vaardigheden 

- sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en kun je helder en gestructureerd rapporteren 

- duidelijke interesse in en affiniteit met de energietransitie en verduurzamingsvraagstukken 

- de intrinsieke drive om maatschappelijke impact te maken. 

Dit bieden we jou 

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en creëren volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. 

Daarnaast bieden we: 

- een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,– per maand (op fulltimebasis) 

- een laptop 

- flexibele (thuis)werkmogelijkheden 

- persoonlijke begeleiding door een ervaren adviseur 

- een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng 

- de mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en onze relaties 

- de mogelijkheid om in te stromen in een Berenschot-traineeship. 

Om stage te kunnen lopen bij Berenschot, moet je gedurende de gehele stageperiode ingeschreven staan bij een universitaire onderwijsinstelling. Afstuderen bij ons is een optie, de mogelijkheden van een scriptie bespreken we graag samen verder met je. 

Solliciteer meteen 

Wil jij ook een trotse Berenschotter worden? Solliciteer direct! Stuur je cv en motivatie naar Vicky Schats. Neem bij vragen gerust contact op met Vicky Schats via WhatsApp (06 25 72 26 12) of per e-mail ( ).

Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt.
