title: Engineering Manager
description:
At NetBox Labs , our mission is to make it easier to build and manage complex networks. As a product company, we do that by developing innovative software for network professionals delivered on-premises and in the cloud.

We believe in the power of community and collaboration, and we are looking for a hands-on, player-coach Engineering Manager to lead one of our talented teams. These teams build our core software applications including NetBox and NetBox Add-ons, SDKs, and Plugins, and our observability suite including Diode, Diode Agents and SDKs, and Orb. Much of this development is open source and done in collaboration with our community, but also spans source-available and proprietary software. This role reports to the Director of Engineering.

In this role you will: 

- 
Lead a squad of engineers day-to-day while staying hands-on: reviewing code, jumping into design discussions, and occasionally shipping code yourself to unblock the team or model best practices.

- 
Drive execution relentlessly — break down ambiguous problems into clear plans, set sprint goals, remove blockers fast, and hold the team accountable to deadlines.

- 
Own the software development lifecycle for your team's projects, from planning and design through implementation, testing, and release.

- 
Run effective sprint planning, stand-ups, and retros using GitHub and internal tools, helping engineers break work into well-scoped, executable pieces.

- 
Champion modern, secure software development practices and keep quality bars high without slowing the team down.

- 
Partner closely with product managers to translate customer and community problems into shippable plans, pushing back with data when scope or timelines don't add up.

- 
Coach and mentor engineers individually — give direct, timely feedback, help them grow technically, and build a strong bench for future hiring.

- 
Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team.

- 
Act as a liaison between your team and the broader tech community, supporting open-source contributors and guiding community-facing initiatives where relevant.

- 
Report progress transparently to engineering leadership, flagging risks early rather than after they've become problems.

- 
Stay close enough to the code and the architecture to make credible calls on technical trade-offs, while trusting your engineers to own the details of implementation.

You will work closely with: 

- 
Director of Engineering to coordinate cross-functional initiatives and ensure your team's work runs smoothly in our commercial products.

- 
Product team to understand customer and community problems and turn them into a stellar user experience.

- 
Peer engineering managers to plan cross-functional projects, clarify ownership, surface dependencies, and clear blockers together.

Qualifications: 

- 
2+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager or Team Lead, ideally in a player-coach capacity where you're still writing code or reviewing PRs regularly.

- 
A track record of driving projects to completion on tight timelines, with a strong bias toward action and unblocking your team over process for its own sake.

- 
Strong technical background sufficient to review designs and code, and earn credibility with senior engineers.

- 
Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps, and CI/CD in a fast-moving environment.

- 
Proficiency with GitHub for code management, project tracking, and collaboration.

- 
Solid understanding of software security principles and practices.

- 
Experience with open-source software development and community engagement is a plus.

- 
Excellent, direct communication skills — comfortable giving and receiving fast feedback in a remote, async-first environment.

- 
Proven ability to coach engineers and help them grow, while still being the person who rolls up their sleeves when the team needs it.

It would be fantastic if you have the following background: 

- 
Networking industry experience.

- 
Familiarity with Python, Django, Go, gRPC, or OpenTelemetry.

- 
Knowledge of cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure).

- 
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

- 
Understanding of data privacy regulations and compliance requirements.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

- 
Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

- 
We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

- 
Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. title: Chief Technology Officer - US-Based
description:
About Toptal 

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce .

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. 

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering 

- Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.

- Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.

- Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.

- Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability 

- Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.

- Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.

- Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution 

- Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.

- Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

In the first week, expect to:

- Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.

- Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.

In the first month, expect to:

- Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.

- Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.

In the first three months, expect to:

- Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.

- Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.

In the first six months, expect to:

- Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.

- Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

In the first year, expect to:

- Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.

- Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.

- 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.

- Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.

- Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.

- Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.

- Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.

- Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.

- You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.

- Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.

- Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.

- Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.

- Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.

- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

- Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.

- You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

- Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.

- Work independently with minimal supervision.

- Use all required digital collaboration tools.

- Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

title: Developer Advocate
description:
Who We Are 

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more .

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What You'll Do 

You’ll be responsible for driving our goals for enabling every developer to build with computer vision. You’re not starting from scratch, over a million developers use Roboflow today. We have the raw materials ready to be molded and scaled by a DevRel leader.

Responsibilities include:

- 
Drive awareness and adoption of Roboflow tools in the developer community

- 
Develop tools and integrations to help make Roboflow easier and better for software developers to use

- 
Build projects that will help improve the bleeding edge of the main Roboflow product

- 
Create demos, applications, and technical content while sharing your progress online and promoting Roboflow on social media (ie X, LinkedIn, Twitch, etc)

- 
Create content to educate, inspire, and equip technical audiences with tools and techniques that make them better at their craft

- 
Work with Product, Engineering, and Design to develop new projects in support of the launch of new features

- 
Write guides, examples, and documentation to make our software more accessible and understandable.

- 
Be an active participant in communities like HN, relevant subreddits, Discord groups, GitHub Issues, and the Roboflow forum.

You may also have or quickly develop ideas for amplifying and expanding our community even more -- and we can’t wait to support those as well.

Who You Are 

- 
4+ years of engineering experience

- 
2 + years of DevRel related experience, preference for products in B2B, AI, cloud, and/or developer tools

- 
Track record of shipping software projects with fast adoption and viral growth, either as part of a previous job or on your own

- 
Technical background that enables you to build fast and learn new things quickly

- 
Translate complex information into engaging and easy-to-understand content, guides, tutorials, examples, and applications

- 
End-to-end content creation skillset across written, video, and social media

- 
Self-starter with the ability to analyze ambiguous situations, develop a plan, execute and iterate

- 
Operate with urgency, build consensus, and lead cross-functional teams.

- 
Customer focus and motivated to become an expert on our industry, customers, product, ecosystem, and competitors.

- 
Active contributor to communities online and/or in-person

- 
Bonus: you currently have an engaged following online and an interest in growing your personal audience

Who You'll Be Working With 

You will directly be working with our Marketing Lead, Open Source Lead, co-founders, Product Engineers, and Product Designers.

We are currently a team of 70 team members located all over the US and Europe. Our team’s backgrounds range from high school whiz kids, former founders of technology companies and fashion lines, world-class engineers, CMOs to CEOs, and have experience scaling businesses to millions in revenue. We want to work with exceptional people with a diverse background. At this early stage, you'll have the ability to work cross-functionally with many members of the team and solve a wide array of problems.

Where You'll Work 

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco with a mindset of opening more offices as we grow. We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities ) and resources (like a travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs, work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best. Learn more about how we work at Roboflow .

When You'll Work 

We don’t have a particular time-zone preference for this role. We have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.

What You'll Receive 

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every 6 months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

- 
$4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

- 
$350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

- 
$350/mo AI Tools

- 
$150/mo Team lunch

-

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Who We Are 

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more .

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What You'll Do 

You'll be tasked with a wide range of projects. Each engineer has a realm they focus on, but we're still small enough that we don't have the luxury of deep specialization. We're looking for technical generalists that aren’t afraid to dive into a new stack or toolchain if the need arises (but JavaScript and Node.js make up the brunt of the existing codebase).

Most of the things we work on are parts of the core product (which is an end-to-end pipeline for building computer vision projects spanning from image ingestion to annotation to training and deployment) but from time to time we're also working on things like integrating marketing and sales tools, fighting fires, automating internal processes, and open source projects.

You'll have a wide degree of freedom to advocate for which projects you think should be highest priority and will contribute to our strategy decisions. If you need a rigid list of tasks spelled out in a multi-month roadmap, this role probably won't be a good fit.

The majority of our codebase is written in JavaScript, our machine learning and image processing pipeline is in Python. We run primarily on Firebase and GCS, with some machine learning infrastructure on AWS. We're increasingly using Docker (both internally and for customer facing products like our edge inference server). A lot of our code runs in the browser (including some Tensorflow JS) but we're also working on building APIs and client libraries in several languages.

You certainly don't need to be experienced in all of these areas; but should be excited to learn new skill sets as you need them. We also hope you'll bring some new knowledge and experiences you can share to help level-up the rest of the team.

We’re especially keen to add some rigor to our processes and build the foundation for rapidly scaling the engineering organization (for example: we currently have limited tests and are not using an opinionated front-end framework -- things that will need to change over the coming months in order to be able to seamlessly expand the team).

Example Projects 

- 
Creating a filtering interface so our users can mix and match their images based on metadata like the time of day they were captured, the GPS location, or custom tags they've applied.

- 
Expanding our annotation tool to support new functionality (like polygonal annotations image segmentation).

- 
Integrating the core app with external APIs for things like outsourcing annotation tasks and analyzing deployed model performance.

- 
Streamlining our onboarding flow.

- 
Deeper integrations with our other products like Roboflow Universe and our REST API.

- 
Next-generation model assisted labeling.

- 
Optimizing speed and scalability.

Who You'll Be Working With 

Our team of ~120 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

You will directly be working with our Engineering Lead and a team of Full Stack Engineers.

Where You'll Work 

Roboflow is fully distributed. We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You'll Work 

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week. Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.

What You'll Receive 

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

The target compensation for this role is $165,000 - $195,000 base.

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

- 
$4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

- 
$350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

- 
$350/mo AI Tools stipend

- 
$150/mo team lunch stipend

- 
$500/one time home office stipend

- 
Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

- 
Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process (6+ hours) 

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We are all motivated to work with an exceptional team and don't currently have in-house recruiters. You will be speaking directly with our team about what it's like to work and thrive at Roboflow. We like to be decisive and work fast, so don't be surprised if all the below conversations happen over a day or two.

Introduction Phase: 

- 
[30m] Meet with hiring manager for introduction to assess overall mindset and skillset.

- 
[60m] Technical assessment with a Roboflow engineer.

Build with Roboflow Phase: 

- 
You will build a small project with Roboflow to showcase your technical and product skills.

Team Interview Phase: 

- 
[45m] Meet with your hiring manager and our CTO to demo your project

Final Interview Stage: 

- 
[45m] Meet with Head of Operations for a culture discussion.

- 
[60m / Optional] Meet with CEO.

If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role or subscribe to our career newsletter by emailing "Subscribe" to operations@roboflow.com . We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

title: Chief Architect
description:
Chief Architect 

Remote - US 

Legion Technologies is building the AI-powered operating system for the hourly workforce. We are hiring a Chief Architect to serve as Legion’s most senior hands-on technical leader and to shape the technical foundation that will power the next decade of product innovation.

This is not a strategy-only or advisory role. The Chief Architect must live close to the code, go deep with engineering teams, challenge assumptions, write and review technical designs, make high-consequence architecture decisions, and help turn bold product ambitions into scalable, reliable production systems.

This person will own architecture and technical decision-making for the most complex parts of Legion’s Workforce Management platform, including AI, optimization, forecasting, scheduling, distributed systems, data platforms, real-time decisioning, enterprise scalability, security, compliance, and developer productivity. 

The ideal candidate has built and scaled mission-critical software used by large enterprise customers, has deep technical credibility with senior engineers, and can operate fluidly between code-level decisions and long-term platform strategy. They are pragmatic, decisive, opinionated, and comfortable making hard tradeoffs when simplicity, scalability, reliability, or customer trust require it.

This role reports to the Head of Product, Engineering, and Support. This is an open role currently being filled on an interim basis by the CEO.

Responsibilities and Duties 

Hands-On Architecture and Technical Decision-Making 

Serve as Legion’s senior-most hands-on technical authority for complex architecture, system design, and platform evolution. 

- Personally dive into code, design documents, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and implementation tradeoffs to diagnose root causes and guide technical direction.

- Lead the hardest technical decisions across AI systems, optimization engines, distributed systems, data architecture, reliability, scalability, security, and platform modernization.

- Write prototypes, reference implementations, architecture decision records, technical specifications, and design patterns where needed to unblock teams and establish clear direction.

- Make high-consequence technical decisions with incomplete information, balancing correctness, simplicity, speed, scalability, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability.

- Challenge architectural drift, unnecessary complexity, weak abstractions, and short-term decisions that create long-term platform risk.

- Partner directly with Staff, Principal, and senior engineering leaders in design reviews, code-level discussions, and implementation planning.

Platform Architecture and Technical Vision 

- Define and own the long-term architecture for Legion’s AI-driven Workforce Management platform across application services, data infrastructure, ML systems, optimization engines, APIs, integration architecture, developer platforms, and enterprise-scale operations.

- Establish engineering-wide standards for system design, scalability, performance, reliability, extensibility, observability, security, and maintainability.

- Serve as the final architectural authority for major platform initiatives and technical decisions with long-term consequences.

- Identify opportunities to reduce complexity, improve system efficiency, accelerate engineering velocity, and unlock new product capabilities.

- Proactively surface technical debt, architectural risk, and platform constraints before they compound into customer, product, or engineering velocity issues.

- Create pragmatic migration paths from current-state architecture to target-state architecture while maintaining uptime, customer trust, backward compatibility, and delivery speed.

- Ensure Legion’s architecture supports enterprise configurability and extensibility without allowing uncontrolled customization or product fragmentation.

AI, Optimization, and Decision Systems 

- Architect AI-native product capabilities across forecasting, scheduling, labor optimization, recommendations, copilots or agents, anomaly detection, decision automation, and other intelligent workforce management use cases.

- Define the architecture for production AI systems, including data pipelines, feature platforms, model training, model serving, retrieval, evaluation, monitoring, feedback loops, and continuous improvement.

- Make clear build-versus-buy decisions across LLMs, classical ML, optimization solvers, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, and internal AI platforms.

- Partner closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to turn mathematically complex labor optimization problems into reliable, scalable, explainable production systems.

- Establish standards for AI system quality, including accuracy, latency, cost, explainability, drift detection, reliability, customer-specific behavior, and production observability.

- Ensure Legion’s AI capabilities remain differentiated, defensible, enterprise-ready, and deeply integrated into operational workflows rather than bolted on as superficial features.

Distributed Systems, Data, and Enterprise Scale 

- Drive architecture for large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS systems serving complex enterprise customers with high availability, performance, security, and compliance expectations.

- Lead technical decisions involving microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed data processing, real-time systems, data governance, and large-scale analytics.

- Improve the architecture for observability, incident analysis, performance engineering, capacity planning, reliability, and operational excellence.

- Use production data, incidents, escalations, and customer operational patterns as inputs into architecture and platform improvement.

- Ensure architectural decisions support global scale, data residency, enterprise integrations, configurability, extensibility, and long-term platform leverage.

Product, Business, and Customer Impact 

- Connect technical decisions directly to customer value, product velocity, implementation speed, scalability, reliability, and long-term platform advantage.

- Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate ambitious product goals into executable architecture and technical roadmaps.

- Understand enterprise customer complexity and design systems that support real-world operational variability without creating unsustainable technical debt.

- Support strategic customer, partner, and vendor architecture discussions where deep technical credibility is required.

- Help evaluate technical implications of major product, partner, platform, and commercial decisions.

Engineering Culture and Technical Talent 

- Mentor and elevate Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, architects, and senior engineering leaders across the organization.

- Raise the bar for technical judgment, system design, architecture reviews, documentation, code quality, operational discipline, and engineering craftsmanship.

- Help assess, attract, and develop senior technical talent, including Staff, Principal, and architect-level engineers.

- Build a culture of disciplined technical thinking, direct debate, clear decision-making, and pragmatic execution.

- Ensure architectural decisions are documented clearly, understood broadly, and translated into executable engineering plans.

Security, Compliance, and Enterprise Readiness 

- Own the architectural approach to enterprise security, data governance, privacy, compliance, auditability, and resilience.

- Ensure architecture supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, data residency, access control, tenant isolation, regulatory requirements, and other needs of large global enterprise customers.

- Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Product, and Engineering teams to make security and compliance foundational architectural properties rather than after-the-fact controls.

Travel Requirements 

- Up to 15% travel for leadership collaboration, engineering offsites, strategic customer engagements, and other business-critical meetings.

Required Skills and Qualifications 

Experience Level 

15+ years of experience building and scaling large-scale software systems. Prior experience as a Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Principal Architect, very senior Principal Engineer, or equivalent senior technical leadership role. 

- Demonstrated success designing and scaling mission-critical, multi-tenant SaaS platforms for enterprise customers.

- Deep hands-on experience with large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, data platforms, APIs, event-driven systems, platform engineering, and high-availability production environments.

- Proven ability to operate as a hands-on technical leader who can credibly engage in code-level and design-level discussions with senior engineers.

- Experience making major architecture decisions for systems with high scale, high reliability requirements, complex domain logic, and long product lifecycles.

- Experience modernizing large production systems incrementally while maintaining uptime, backward compatibility, customer trust, and engineering velocity.

- Experience building or supporting AI, ML, optimization, decisioning, forecasting, or data-intensive products in production.

- Strong understanding of observability, incident response, performance engineering, reliability architecture, capacity planning, and operational excellence.

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineering teams, executives, customers, and cross-functional partners.

Technical Depth 

- Deep expertise in distributed systems, system design, cloud architecture, service-oriented or microservices architectures, APIs, event-driven systems, and large-scale data processing.

- Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

- Strong experience with modern engineering practices, including architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, testing strategy, deployment architecture, observability, and production operations.

- Experience with languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, Python, Scala, or similar modern backend languages.

- Ability to reason deeply about tradeoffs involving performance, latency, throughput, cost, reliability, developer productivity, extensibility, and maintainability.

Leadership and Judgment 

- Strong architectural judgment: knows when to simplify, when to re-platform, when to tolerate debt, and when to force a hard technical reset.

- Demonstrated ability to make bold technical decisions with incomplete information and drive alignment across senior technical and executive stakeholders.

- Ability to influence without relying on hierarchy, while still being willing to make clear decisions when consensus is insufficient.

- Strong product and business judgment; able to connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes, implementation speed, product differentiation, and company strategy.

- Pragmatic builder mindset: balances long-term architecture with startup speed, customer urgency, and execution realities.

Preferred Qualifications and Attributes 

- Experience building platforms used by millions of users or supporting very large-scale enterprise operations.

- Experience at companies known for large-scale distributed systems, AI, cloud infrastructure, enterprise SaaS, workforce management, supply chain, fintech, commerce, logistics, or other complex operational domains.

- Familiarity with optimization engines, scheduling algorithms, forecasting systems, constraint solvers, real-time decision systems, or mathematically complex production systems.

title: Fullstack Engineer
description:
About Us 

The financial advisory industry is a $80T market in the US, but has seen little technological innovation compared to the self-service market (Robinhood, Betterment, Wealthfront, SoFi). Client data management is a universally painful and expensive problem for financial advisors. Today, advisors manually collect, update, and utilize client data across the 7-10 software tools that they use to run their business. Data transcription and translation across systems is time-consuming and error-prone, leading to costly inefficiencies and embarrassing client-facing problems. Managing data access control, audit logs, and compliance is a constant challenge, particularly in larger organizations.

We are building the first wealth tech data orchestration company. We sync client data across a financial advisor's tech stack, unlocking the efficiency of a fully-integrated software suite with the choice of tools that best fit their business. We are laser-focused on enabling the best technology experiences for advisors and unlocking the potential of the entire wealth tech software ecosystem. We’re an experienced team of start-up operators with deep roots in both tech and advisory. You can learn more about us on our website .

We're looking for a fullstack engineer to build features across our platform. You'll own end-to-end delivery of product workflows, working across frontend interfaces and backend services to help financial advisors manage client data seamlessly across their tech stack.

You'll stand out if you have:

Background at startups where you had to wear multiple hats and ship features independently.

We’re a highly experienced team with a track record of successfully building together. We’re well-versed in building for the best tech companies and asset managers.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
emerchantpay is a leading global payment service provider and acquirer for online, mobile, in-store and over the phone payments. Our global payments solution is available through a simple integration, offering a diverse range of features, including global acquiring, global and local payment methods, advanced fraud management and performance optimisation. We empower businesses to design seamless and engaging payment experiences for their consumers.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI Engineering team and help design, build, and roll out production-grade AI solutions, with a strong focus on AI engineering, AI agents, agentic workflows, machine learning, GenAI, and LLM-based applications .

This is a senior individual contributor role within the AI Engineering team. The Senior AI Engineer will work closely with the AI Tech Lead , engineering teams, product stakeholders, data teams, cloud/platform teams, and security teams to deliver reliable AI capabilities into real business systems.

The technology stack is diverse and can include Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) or equivalent frameworks; React on the frontend side, and various ML/AI frameworks, APIs, cloud-native services, along with modern AI tooling .

The role will have a strong focus on AWS , including Amazon Bedrock , Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , Amazon SageMaker , and other AWS AI/ML services.

Responsibilities 

- Design, build, and maintain AI-powered applications, services, and integrations as part of the AI Engineering team.
- Implement solutions focused on AI agents, agentic workflows, automation, LLM-based applications, and AI-assisted business processes .
- Build and integrate AI applications using technologies such as Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) or equivalent frameworks, React frontends, and relevant AI/ML frameworks .
- Implement AI solutions using AWS AI/ML services , including Amazon Bedrock , Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , Amazon SageMaker , and other AWS services for model hosting, inference, orchestration, data processing, monitoring, and security.
- Work closely with the AI Tech Lead to align on architecture, technology choices, engineering standards, AI patterns, and rollout approaches.
- Provide technical input and guidance to other engineers on AI implementation patterns, code quality, testing, observability, and production readiness.
- Develop and integrate AI agents that interact with internal APIs, business workflows, enterprise systems, knowledge bases, and external tools in a safe and controlled way.
- Build and maintain RAG-based solutions , including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval logic, reranking, and grounding techniques.
- Support the development and deployment of machine learning models and AI solutions into production environments.
- Contribute to ML pipelines and MLOps practices , including data preparation, model training, experiment tracking, model deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and lifecycle management.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.

The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Tala is seeking a driven engineer to join our growing Product Development team. The ideal candidate is adept at problem-solving and debugging, and is committed to continuously improving existing systems and processes. You will work closely with fellow Tala engineers to build and extend Tala's backend architecture to support new country launches, new features, and a fast growing user base.

The Senior Backend Engineer owns systems and initiatives that span a domain. You set your own technical approach, need minimal technical guidance, and raise the domain's quality bar through design, review, and partnership with peers. As a technologist and a leader, you push the team toward a highly available, scalable, reliable, fault tolerant, and performant microservices platform. You follow and improve Tala's engineering processes and standards while advancing Tala's mission and business objectives.

This is a technical leadership role within Tala's technical track, set in a supportive team environment with significant opportunities for career advancement and professional development. You will collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the globe.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Engineering 

- 
Design, develop, and maintain backend services, APIs, and data integration layers that power key product features.

- 
Author design documents (EDDs) for services in the domain and defend them in review.

- 
Design and optimize database schemas and queries for performance and system reliability.

- 
Meet project goals without trading away quality, and pay down technical debt as part of delivery rather than as a separate request.

- 
Serve as the go-to person for one or more technologies in the domain, following industry developments and explaining concretely how they would or would not apply at Tala.

Quality, Review, and Standards 

- 
Hold the domain's engineering bar in code and design reviews, including for work from other technical teams.

- 
Write clean, maintainable code that follows established coding standards.

- 
Contribute to the testing infrastructure to increase coverage for backend modules.

- 
Verify AI-assisted changes to the same standard as hand-written code.

Reliability and Operations 

- 
Define alerting, SLIs, and SLOs, and advance monitoring of backend modules so availability and response times improve proactively.

- 
Handle incidents that the runbook does not cover, fill runbook gaps found during a shift, lead the technical response for domain incidents, and write the RCA.

- 
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues quickly across development and production environments.

Delivery and Collaboration 

- 
Own delivery of domain roadmap work and take part in quarterly and sprint planning with a view on feasibility.

- 
Anticipate blockers before sprint commitment, and escalate with a problem statement, an impact assessment, and proposed options.

- 
Work with Product and business stakeholders to remove ambiguity and to understand what success means for a feature.

- 
Work with the team lead to deliver domain solutions, and own service design and implementation end to end, including regressions you introduce.

- 
Keep the domain's tickets accurate and its documentation complete enough that it is the first place people look.

- 
Work across multiple time zones using asynchronous communication.

Mentorship 

- 
Act as a dedicated mentor to junior and mid-level engineers, with a clear sense of what each is working to improve.

- 
Technically lead and mentor a team of Backend Engineers building or extending complex modules.

Required Skills and Experience

- 
Language: Fluency in English, including clear written communication, which is how most work happens across time zones.

- 
Backend engineering: Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating applications in Java, Kotlin, and/or Scala, including a web framework such as Spring.

- 
Track record: Has led and delivered multiple domain-significant projects, each validated in production over a meaningful period, including large scale consumer applications on cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) using microservices architecture.

- 
Technical expertise: Subject-matter expert in their own domain and conversant in adjacent ones. Maintains a working mental model of the wider company architecture and where the seams are. Assesses code and design quality beyond their own area.

- 
Solution building and system design: Designs services and their dependencies with security, maintainability, operability, and scale accounted for. Authors design documents (EDDs) and defend them in review. Designs for failure cases, not just the happy path.

- 
API design: Expert knowledge of REST API design and development for mobile and web use.

- 
Judgment and problem framing: Reframes poorly posed problems instead of answering them as asked. Decides with incomplete information and states the assumptions relied on. Distinguishes reversible from irreversible decisions and applies rigor accordingly. Choose the smallest solution that solves the problem.

- 
Data stores: Strong relational database experience (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MS SQL) and strong non-relational database experience (Cassandra, Redshift, DynamoDB, or HDFS).

- 
Testing and observability: Defines alert thresholds, SLIs, and SLOs for the domain along with the telemetry that supports them. Designs for graceful degradation. Ships new features with monitoring already in place. Co-owns Acceptance Tests coverage decisions with SDET and flags testability gaps before release.

- 
Security and compliance: Follows Tala's security and privacy practices in line with ISO-27001 and ISO-27701, follows OWASP secure coding practices, and remediates vulnerabilities within established SLAs.

- 
AI fluency: Knows when not to delegate to AI and decomposes domain work into agent-sized units with explicit acceptance criteria. Builds reusable context assets, prompts, and skills that others in the domain adopt. Sets the verification bar for the domain's AI-assisted work. Is accountable for AI-generated code as if it were hand-written, and never puts PII, borrower or credit data, secrets, or production credentials into a prompt or agent context.

- 
Delivery and impact: Owns delivery of domain roadmap work and balances feature velocity against technical debt deliberately. Owns an outcome rather than a task list, knows which metrics their systems move, and watches them after release.

- 
Ways of working: Expert proficiency in the Agile development process. Prioritizes and communicates well in a fast-paced environment. Strong drive for independent learning and work.

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Manager Software Test Automation
description:
At Veracyte , we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions. 

Our Values:

- We Seek A Better Way : We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.

- We Make It Happen : We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way. 

- We Are Stronger Together : We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team. 

- We Care Deeply : We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another. 

The Position:

Veracyte is seeking an experienced Manager, Software Test Automation, to lead our Quality Engineering Platform team. This team's mission is to enable every product engineering team to own software quality by providing scalable automation frameworks, self-service testing platforms, AI-assisted quality tools, and engineering best practices that accelerate software delivery while improving reliability, security, and compliance.

Rather than functioning as a traditional QA organization, the Quality Engineering Platform team partners with Software Engineering, Product Management, CloudOps, Data & AI, Laboratory Operations, and DevOps to build quality into every stage of the software development lifecycle. The team develops reusable automation platforms, testing infrastructure, quality metrics, and AI-enabled engineering capabilities that allow product teams to continuously validate cloud-native applications, APIs, enterprise integrations, laboratory workflows, and AI-powered solutions.

As the Manager, Software Test Automation you will define Veracyte's quality engineering strategy, establish modern engineering practices, and lead a team of Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs), Automation Engineers, and Quality Platform Engineers responsible for enabling engineering excellence across the organization.

The ideal candidate is a technical leader passionate about developer productivity, platform engineering, intelligent automation, and building a culture where quality is owned by every engineering team. This is a hybrid role in San Diego, CA

Key Responsibilities: 

Engineering Leadership

- Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing Quality Engineering Platform team.

- Define and execute the long-term strategy for quality engineering, automation, and developer enablement.

- Build an engineering culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, ownership, and operational excellence.

- Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent while fostering career growth and technical leadership.

Quality Engineering Platform

- Build and evolve self-service quality engineering platforms that enable product teams to independently validate their software.

- Develop scalable automation frameworks supporting unit, integration, API, UI, end-to-end, regression, performance, security, and compliance testing.

- Create reusable testing libraries, tooling, templates, and CI/CD integrations that standardize quality practices across engineering.

- Define quality engineering standards, reference architectures, and best practices adopted across development teams.

- Enable continuous verification through automated quality gates, production validation, synthetic monitoring, and release health checks.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering

- Define Veracyte's strategy for leveraging AI throughout the software testing lifecycle.

- Build AI-assisted capabilities for automated test generation, regression analysis, defect classification, release risk assessment, test maintenance, and synthetic test data creation.

- Partner with Data & AI teams to develop validation strategies for AI-powered products, including LLM evaluation, prompt regression testing, model monitoring, and human-in-the-loop verification.

- Evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies that improve engineering productivity and software quality.

Developer Enablement

- Partner with Software Engineering teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle using shift-left and shift-right engineering practices.

- Coach engineering teams on automation strategies, testing best practices, and quality ownership.

- Provide consulting, tooling, and technical guidance that enables product teams to deliver software with confidence.

- Partner with DevOps and CloudOps to integrate quality engineering into modern CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native delivery platforms.

Operational Excellence

- Establish engineering metrics that measure software quality, automation effectiveness, developer productivity, release confidence, platform adoption, and customer impact.

- Drive observability, defect prevention, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.

- Ensure software validation activities support regulatory requirements applicable to healthcare diagnostics, including HIPAA, CAP/CLIA, and FDA software quality expectations where appropriate.

Who You Are:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

- 6 – 7 years of software engineering, quality engineering, or software development experience.

- 3+ years leading Quality Engineering, Test Engineering, SDET, or Developer Platform engineering teams.

- Proven experience building engineering platforms that improve software quality and developer productivity.

- Strong background developing automated testing frameworks for cloud-native applications and distributed systems.

- Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices.

- Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering tooling, or self-service engineering capabilities.

- Strong understanding of AWS cloud technologies, APIs, distributed systems, and modern software architecture.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, organizational, and people leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, laboratory information systems (LIS/LIMS), molecular diagnostics, or regulated medical software.

- Experience validating healthcare interoperability standards including HL7, FHIR, X12, and related healthcare transactions.

- Experience testing AI-enabled products, machine learning systems, or generative AI applications.

- Experience using AI-assisted development and testing tools to improve engineering productivity.

- Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, REST Assured, Karate, Postman, JUnit, TestNG, or similar automation technologies.

- Experience building automation using Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#.

- Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud-native platforms.

- Experience implementing performance engineering, security testing, chaos engineering, or site reliability engineering practices.

- Experience working within regulated environments including HIPAA, FDA, CAP/CLIA, ISO 13485, or SOC 2.

- AWS certifications or software testing certifications are a plus.

- Experience leading distributed engineering organizations.

#LI-Hybrid #LI-Remote

$147,000—$163,000 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Build and lead the teams responsible for shared agentic platform capabilities, including reusable agents, workflow orchestration, context and knowledge access, tool integrations, evaluation, observability, and governance.
